intro.en: 10 questions, 30 seconds each. Faster answers win more points. Tip: cover the dialogue first!
intro.zh: 10 道题，每题 30 秒。答得越快分越高。小技巧：先遮住对话！

questions.q:
We packed our swimming bags and ran to catch the school bus.
What is the point of view?

why.en: Look at the pronouns OUTSIDE speech marks. "We" and "our" mean the narrator is one of the people in the story. A narrator inside the story who says I/we = first person.
why.zh: 看引号外的代词。we 和 our 表示叙述者是故事里的人。故事里的人用 I/we 讲故事 = 第一人称。

Second person.en: Second person talks to YOU, the reader (you, your). This story does not talk to the reader.
Second person.zh: 第二人称是对读者“你”说话（you、your）。这个故事没有对读者说话。

Third person.en: Third person uses names and he, she, they. Here the narrator uses I/we or talks to you instead.
Third person.zh: 第三人称用名字和 he、she、they。这里叙述者用的是 I/we 或在对“你”说话。

questions.qzh:
我们收拾好游泳包，跑去赶校车。
这是第几人称？

questions.q:
Have you ever eaten durian? You will never forget the smell!
What is the point of view?

why.en: The narrator speaks straight to the reader with "you" (Have YOU ever...?). Talking to the reader = second person.
why.zh: 叙述者直接用 you 对读者说话（Have YOU ever...?）。对读者说话 = 第二人称。

First person.en: First person uses I, me, my, we, our OUTSIDE the speech marks: the narrator is in the story. These words are not there.
First person.zh: 第一人称在引号外用 I、me、my、we、our：叙述者在故事里。这里没有这些词。

Third person.en: Third person uses names and he, she, they. Here the narrator uses I/we or talks to you instead.
Third person.zh: 第三人称用名字和 he、she、they。这里叙述者用的是 I/we 或在对“你”说话。

questions.qzh:
你吃过榴莲吗？你永远忘不了那个味道！
这是第几人称？

questions.q:
Sophie bought a photo card of her favourite singer. She smiled all the way home.
What is the point of view?

why.en: The narrator is NOT in the story; they tell us about someone else using a name and she/her. Name + he/she/they = third person.
why.zh: 叙述者不在故事里，用名字和 she/her 讲别人的事。名字 + he/she/they = 第三人称。

First person.en: First person uses I, me, my, we, our OUTSIDE the speech marks: the narrator is in the story. These words are not there.
First person.zh: 第一人称在引号外用 I、me、my、we、our：叙述者在故事里。这里没有这些词。

Second person.en: Second person talks to YOU, the reader (you, your). This story does not talk to the reader.
Second person.zh: 第二人称是对读者“你”说话（you、your）。这个故事没有对读者说话。

questions.qzh:
Sophie 买了一张她最喜欢的歌手的小卡。她一路笑着回家。
这是第几人称？

questions.q:
"You are my best friend!" Lily told Emma. Then they hugged.
What is the point of view?

why.en: Cover the dialogue first! "You" is inside the speech marks, so it does not count. Lily, Emma, they = third person.
why.zh: 先遮住对话！“You” 在引号里，不算。Lily、Emma、they = 第三人称。

First person.en: "You" and "my" are inside the speech marks, so they are Lily's words, not the narrator's. Outside: Lily, Emma, they.
First person.zh: you 和 my 在引号里，是 Lily 说的话，不是叙述者的。引号外是 Lily、Emma、they。

Second person.en: The "you" is inside the speech marks: Lily is talking to Emma, not the narrator talking to the reader.
Second person.zh: you 在引号里：是 Lily 在对 Emma 说话，不是叙述者对读者说话。

questions.qzh:
“你是我最好的朋友！”Lily 对 Emma 说。然后她们拥抱了。
这是第几人称？

questions.q:
"I won, I won!" Tom shouted. He held his gold medal high.
What is the point of view?

why.en: Cover the dialogue: "I won" does not count. Tom, he, his = third person.
why.zh: 遮住对话：“I won” 不算。Tom、he、his = 第三人称。

First person.en: "I won" is inside the speech marks, so it is Tom's words. The narrator says Tom, he, his.
First person.zh: I won 在引号里，是 Tom 说的话。叙述者用的是 Tom、he、his。

Second person.en: Second person talks to YOU, the reader (you, your). This story does not talk to the reader.
Second person.zh: 第二人称是对读者“你”说话（you、your）。这个故事没有对读者说话。

questions.qzh:
“我赢了，我赢了！”Tom 喊道。他把金牌高高举起。
这是第几人称？

questions.q:
Have you ever visited a Thai temple? You must take off your shoes first.
What is the point of view?

why.en: Clue words: you, your. The narrator talks to the reader. That is second person.
why.zh: 线索词：you、your，叙述者在对读者说话，是第二人称。

First person.en: First person uses I, me, my, we, our OUTSIDE the speech marks: the narrator is in the story. These words are not there.
First person.zh: 第一人称在引号外用 I、me、my、we、our：叙述者在故事里。这里没有这些词。

Third person.en: Third person uses names and he, she, they. Here the narrator uses I/we or talks to you instead.
Third person.zh: 第三人称用名字和 he、she、they。这里叙述者用的是 I/we 或在对“你”说话。

questions.qzh:
你去过泰国的寺庙吗？你必须先脱鞋。
这是第几人称？

questions.q:
James and Tom carried the bread to the hall. They put it on the long table.
Which kind of third person is it?

why.en: We only SEE actions. We know nobody's feelings, like a camera. That is objective.
why.zh: 我们只看到动作，不知道任何人的感受，像摄像机，所以是客观。

Third person limited.en: Limited means we know the feelings of only ONE character.
Third person limited.zh: 有限视角是只知道一个人物的感受。

Third person omniscient.en: Omniscient means we know the feelings of EVERYONE (omni = all).
Third person omniscient.zh: 全知视角是知道每个人的感受（omni = 全部）。

questions.qzh:
James 和 Tom 把面包搬到大厅。他们把面包放在长桌上。
这是哪一种第三人称？

questions.q:
Lily wanted to sing on stage, but she was scared her voice would shake.
Which kind of third person is it?

why.en: We know the feelings of ONE person: Lily. That is limited.
why.zh: 我们只知道一个人（Lily）的感受，所以是有限。

Third person objective.en: Objective is like a camera: we only SEE what people do, and we know nobody's feelings.
Third person objective.zh: 客观视角像摄像机：只看到人们做什么，不知道任何人的感受。

Third person omniscient.en: Omniscient means we know the feelings of EVERYONE (omni = all).
Third person omniscient.zh: 全知视角是知道每个人的感受（omni = 全部）。

questions.qzh:
Lily 想上台唱歌，但她怕自己的声音会发抖。
这是哪一种第三人称？

questions.q:
Daisy felt proud of her drawing. Emma felt a little jealous, and the teacher was delighted.
Which kind of third person is it?

why.en: We know how EVERYONE feels: Daisy, Emma and the teacher. That is omniscient.
why.zh: 我们知道每个人的感受：Daisy、Emma 和老师，所以是全知。

Third person objective.en: Objective is like a camera: we only SEE what people do, and we know nobody's feelings.
Third person objective.zh: 客观视角像摄像机：只看到人们做什么，不知道任何人的感受。

Third person limited.en: Limited means we know the feelings of only ONE character.
Third person limited.zh: 有限视角是只知道一个人物的感受。

questions.qzh:
Daisy 为自己的画感到骄傲。Emma 有点嫉妒，老师很高兴。
这是哪一种第三人称？

questions.q:
The swimmers dived into the pool. The crowd clapped and cheered.
Which kind of third person is it?

why.en: Only actions, no feelings. Like a camera. That is objective.
why.zh: 只有动作，没有感受，像摄像机，所以是客观。

Third person limited.en: Limited means we know the feelings of only ONE character.
Third person limited.zh: 有限视角是只知道一个人物的感受。

Third person omniscient.en: Omniscient means we know the feelings of EVERYONE (omni = all).
Third person omniscient.zh: 全知视角是知道每个人的感受（omni = 全部）。

questions.qzh:
游泳运动员跳进泳池。观众拍手欢呼。
这是哪一种第三人称？

questions.q:
Sophie was nervous about the test, and Lily was worried about her too. Their teacher felt sure they would both do well.
Which kind of third person is it?

why.en: We know the feelings of Sophie, Lily AND the teacher. All of them = omniscient.
why.zh: 我们知道 Sophie、Lily 和老师的感受。所有人 = 全知。

Third person objective.en: Objective is like a camera: we only SEE what people do, and we know nobody's feelings.
Third person objective.zh: 客观视角像摄像机：只看到人们做什么，不知道任何人的感受。

Third person limited.en: Limited means we know the feelings of only ONE character.
Third person limited.zh: 有限视角是只知道一个人物的感受。

questions.qzh:
Sophie 担心考试，Lily 也替她担心。她们的老师相信她们俩都会考好。
这是哪一种第三人称？

questions.q:
Tom smiled at the new girl. He hoped she would sit next to him at lunch.
Which kind of third person is it?

why.en: We only know what Tom hopes. One person = limited.
why.zh: 我们只知道 Tom 的想法。一个人 = 有限。

Third person objective.en: Objective is like a camera: we only SEE what people do, and we know nobody's feelings.
Third person objective.zh: 客观视角像摄像机：只看到人们做什么，不知道任何人的感受。

Third person omniscient.en: Omniscient means we know the feelings of EVERYONE (omni = all).
Third person omniscient.zh: 全知视角是知道每个人的感受（omni = 全部）。

questions.qzh:
Tom 对新来的女孩笑了笑。他希望她午饭时坐在他旁边。
这是哪一种第三人称？

questions.q:
It rains all day. Daisy is sad because her swimming lesson is cancelled. Farmer Tom is happy because his plants need water.
This shows that the two characters have different...

why.en: They see the SAME rain in different ways. HOW a character sees something is perspective.
why.zh: 他们看同一场雨的感受不同。人物怎样看一件事就是“看法”。

themes.en: A theme is a life lesson for everyone. This is about how each character SEES the rain.
themes.zh: 主题是给所有人的人生道理。这里讲的是每个人物怎样看待下雨。

narrators.en: The narrator is who tells the story. There is one narrator here; the two characters just feel differently.
narrators.zh: 叙述者是讲故事的人。这里只有一个叙述者，两个人物只是感受不同。

dialogues.en: Dialogue is people talking with speech marks. Nobody is talking here.
dialogues.zh: 对话是人物说话，有引号。这里没有人说话。

questions.qzh:
下了一整天雨。Daisy 很难过，因为游泳课取消了。农夫 Tom 很开心，因为他的植物需要水。
这说明两个人物有不同的……

questions.q:
"Emma gave the card back to Sophie."
Is this a theme or a summary?

why.en: It tells WHAT HAPPENED and uses names. That is a summary.
why.zh: 它讲的是发生了什么，还有名字，所以是概要。

Theme.en: A theme is a lesson for everyone with no names. This sentence uses names and tells an event.
Theme.zh: 主题是给所有人的道理，没有名字。这句有名字，讲的是一件事。

questions.qzh:
“Emma 把卡还给了 Sophie。”
这是主题还是概要？

questions.q:
"Be honest, even when nobody is watching."
Is this a theme or a summary?

why.en: It is a life lesson for EVERYONE, with no names. That is a theme.
why.zh: 这是对每个人都适用的道理，没有名字，所以是主题。

Summary.en: A summary tells what happened, with names. This is advice for everyone, with no names.
Summary.zh: 概要讲发生了什么，有名字。这是给所有人的建议，没有名字。

questions.qzh:
“要诚实，就算没有人看着。”
这是主题还是概要？

canNow.en: I can now find the point of view and tell a theme from a summary.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以找出叙述视角，并分清主题和概要。

intro.en: Learn the key words, read the story, answer the questions, then write the theme.

keywords.meaning: a small card with a picture of a singer
I felt sad and worried inside

keywords.zh: 她的脸一下子亮了起来（很开心）

keywords.meaning: happy and kind feelings in your heart

paragraphs: My name is Emma, and I love K-pop. On Monday, I found a photo card on the bus floor. It was my favourite singer, and it was very rare! I was so excited. I wanted to keep it.
Then I saw a younger girl at the back of the bus. She was crying and looking under every seat. "My sister gave it to me for my birthday," she said to her friend.
My heart felt heavy. I walked over and held out the card. "Is this yours?" I asked. The girl's face lit up. "Thank you so much!" she said. Her name was Sophie.
I did not have the rare card any more, but I felt warm and happy inside. It was a better feeling than keeping it.

questions.q: What is the point of view of this story?

why.en: Clue words outside the dialogue: My, I, me. That is first person.
why.zh: 对话外面的线索词：My、I、me，所以是第一人称。

Second person.en: Second person talks to YOU, the reader (you, your). This story does not talk to the reader.
Second person.zh: 第二人称是对读者“你”说话（you、your）。这个故事没有对读者说话。

Third person.en: Third person uses names and he, she, they. Here the narrator uses I/we or talks to you instead.
Third person.zh: 第三人称用名字和 he、she、they。这里叙述者用的是 I/we 或在对“你”说话。

questions.qzh: 这个故事是第几人称？

questions.q: Who is the narrator?

why.en: "My name is Emma." Emma tells the story.
why.zh: “My name is Emma.” 是 Emma 在讲故事。

Sophie.en: Sophie is a character the narrator talks ABOUT. The narrator says "My name is Emma".
Sophie.zh: Sophie 是叙述者讲到的人物。叙述者说的是 My name is Emma。

Sophie's sister.en: Sophie's sister is only mentioned; she does not tell the story.
Sophie's sister.zh: Sophie 的姐姐只是被提到，不是讲故事的人。

the bus driver.en: The bus driver does not say "I" in the story. Emma does.
the bus driver.zh: 司机在故事里没有用 I 说话，是 Emma 在说。

questions.qzh: 谁是叙述者？

questions.q: How did Emma feel when she FIRST found the card?

why.en: Paragraph 1: "I was so excited."

intro.en: A run-on is two complete sentences joined with nothing, or only a comma. Fix 1: full stop + capital letter. Fix 2: comma + and / but / so.
intro.zh: 连写句是两个完整的句子连在一起，中间没有标点或只有逗号。改法 1：句号 + 大写。改法 2：逗号 + and / but / so。

questions.q: Which one is a RUN-ON sentence?
options: I like bread it is soft.

why.en: A run-on sentence is TWO complete sentences pushed together with no full stop or joining word. "I like bread" + "it is soft" = two sentences with nothing between.
why.zh: 连写句是两个完整的句子挤在一起，中间没有句号或连接词。I like bread + it is soft = 两个句子中间什么都没有。

I like bread..en: This is ONE complete sentence with a full stop. Nothing is joined wrongly.
I like bread..zh: 这是一个完整的句子，有句号，没有连错。

I like soft bread..en: One subject (I), one verb (like): a single correct sentence.
I like soft bread..zh: 一个主语（I）、一个动词（like）：一个正确的句子。

Soft bread is nice..en: One subject (soft bread), one verb (is): a single correct sentence.
Soft bread is nice..zh: 一个主语（soft bread）、一个动词（is）：一个正确的句子。

questions.qzh: 哪一个是连写句（run-on sentence）？

options: Tom ran, but he was late.

why.en: Two complete sentences joined with only a comma is still a run-on. It needs "but" or a full stop.
why.zh: 两个完整的句子只用逗号连起来，还是连写句。需要加 but 或句号。

Tom ran, but he was late..en: The joining word "but" after the comma links the two ideas correctly.
Tom ran, but he was late..zh: 逗号后面有连接词 but，正确地连起了两个意思。

Tom ran fast..en: This is one complete sentence, so it is correct.
Tom ran fast..zh: 这是一个完整的句子，是对的。

Tom was late..en: This is one complete sentence, so it is correct.
Tom was late..zh: 这是一个完整的句子，是对的。

questions.qzh: 哪一个是连写句（run-on sentence）？

questions.q: Choose the best fix: Emma loves K-pop she dances every day.
options: Emma loves K-pop, she dances every day.
Emma loves K-pop. She dances every day.
Emma loves K-pop she. Dances every day.
emma loves K-pop. she dances every day.

why.en: Fix a run-on by ending the first sentence with a full stop and starting the next with a CAPITAL letter: Emma loves K-pop. She dances every day.
why.zh: 改连写句：第一句用句号结束，下一句用大写字母开头：Emma loves K-pop. She dances every day.

Emma loves K-pop, she dances every day..en: This joins two complete sentences with only a comma. A comma alone cannot join two sentences: that is a comma splice, a kind of run-on.
Emma loves K-pop, she dances every day..zh: 这只用逗号连接两个完整的句子。逗号不能单独连接两个句子：这叫逗号粘连，也是连写句。

Emma loves K-pop she. Dances every day..en: The full stop is in the wrong place. "She" belongs to the second sentence; "Dances every day" has no subject.
Emma loves K-pop she. Dances every day..zh: 句号放错了。She 属于第二句；Dances every day 没有主语。

emma loves K-pop. she dances every day..en: The full stop is right, but every sentence and every name must start with a CAPITAL letter: Emma, She.
emma loves K-pop. she dances every day..zh: 句号对了，但每个句子和名字都要大写开头：Emma、She。

questions.qzh: 选最好的改法：Emma loves K-pop she dances every day.

questions.q: Choose the best fix: My grandma smiled she gave me a big hug.
options: My grandma smiled, she gave me a big hug.
My grandma smiled and, she gave me a big hug.
My grandma smiled, and she gave me a big hug.
my grandma smiled. she gave me a big hug.

why.en: Another way to fix a run-on: add a comma AND a joining word (and, but, so) between the two sentences: My grandma smiled, and she gave me a big hug.
why.zh: 改连写句的另一种方法：在两个句子之间加逗号和连接词（and、but、so）：My grandma smiled, and she gave me a big hug.

My grandma smiled, she gave me a big hug.en: This joins two complete sentences with only a comma. A comma alone cannot join two sentences: that is a comma splice, a kind of run-on.
My grandma smiled, she gave me a big hug.zh: 这只用逗号连接两个完整的句子。逗号不能单独连接两个句子：这叫逗号粘连，也是连写句。

My grandma smiled and, she gave me a big.en: The comma goes BEFORE "and", not after it.
My grandma smiled and, she gave me a big.zh: 逗号要放在 and 前面，不是后面。

my grandma smiled. she gave me a big hug.en: The full stop is fine, but each sentence must start with a capital: My, She.
my grandma smiled. she gave me a big hug.zh: 句号可以，但每个句子要大写开头：My、She。

questions.qzh: 选最好的改法：My grandma smiled she gave me a big hug.

questions.q: Choose the best fix: I dropped my phone, the screen cracked.
options: I dropped my phone, so the screen cracked.
I dropped my phone the screen cracked.
I dropped, my phone the screen cracked.
I dropped my phone, the Screen cracked.

why.en: A comma alone cannot join two sentences. Add a joining word: comma + so. "So" also shows the reason: dropping the phone caused the crack.
why.zh: 逗号不能单独连接两个句子，要加连接词：逗号 + so。so 还表示因果：手机掉了导致屏幕裂了。

I dropped my phone the screen cracked..en: This removes the comma and makes it worse: two sentences with nothing between them.
I dropped my phone the screen cracked..zh: 这把逗号也去掉了，更糟：两个句子中间什么都没有。

I dropped, my phone the screen cracked..en: The comma is in the wrong place and the two sentences are still not joined properly.
I dropped, my phone the screen cracked..zh: 逗号放错了位置，两个句子还是没有正确连接。

I dropped my phone, the Screen cracked..en: Still a comma splice, and "screen" is not a name, so it needs no capital.
I dropped my phone, the Screen cracked..zh: 还是逗号粘连，而且 screen 不是名字，不用大写。

questions.qzh: 选最好的改法：I dropped my phone, the screen cracked.

Which part of a speech is this?

why.en: The introduction comes first and grabs the audience's attention, often with a question to the listener.
why.zh: 引言在最前面，用来吸引听众注意，常用一个问听众的问题。

Beginning.en: The beginning of the story tells WHEN and WHERE it happened. A question to the audience comes before that.
Beginning.zh: 故事的开头讲什么时候、在哪里。问听众的问题在这之前。

Middle.en: The middle is the exciting problem or surprise.
Middle.zh: 中间是精彩的问题或意外。

End.en: The end tells how the story finished.

questions.q:
Which part of a speech is this?
"It was Chinese New Year, and I was in Grandma's kitchen."

why.en: It tells WHEN and WHERE. That is the beginning.
why.zh: 它讲了时间和地点，这是开始。

Introduction.en: The introduction grabs attention, often with a question. This sentence sets the time and place.
Introduction.zh: 引言用问题等方式吸引注意。这句交代时间和地点。

Middle.en: The middle is a problem or surprise. Nothing has happened yet here.
Middle.zh: 中间是问题或意外。这里还什么都没发生。

Conclusion.en: The conclusion says what you learned, at the very end.
Conclusion.zh: 结论在最后，说你学到了什么。

questions.qzh:

“那是春节，我在奶奶的厨房里。”

questions.q:
Which part of a speech is this?
"Then, something unexpected happened: my first dumpling burst open in the pot!"

why.en: A problem or surprise is the exciting middle part.
why.zh: 问题或惊喜是最精彩的中间部分。

Beginning.en: The beginning sets the scene (when, where). Words like "Then" and "something unexpected" show the story has moved on.
Beginning.zh: 开头交代场景（时间、地点）。Then 和 something unexpected 表示故事已经往前走了。

End.en: The end tells how the problem was solved. Here the problem is just starting.
End.zh: 结尾讲问题怎么解决。这里问题才刚开始。

Conclusion.en: The conclusion is the lesson learned, not an event.
Conclusion.zh: 结论是学到的道理，不是事件。

questions.qzh:
这是演讲的哪一部分？
“然后，意想不到的事发生了：我的第一个饺子在锅里破开了！”

questions.q:
Which part of a speech is this?
"Finally, Grandma tasted my dumplings and said they were perfect."

why.en: It tells how the story ended. That is the end.
why.zh: 它讲了故事的结果，这是结尾。

Introduction.en: The introduction grabs attention at the start. "Finally" shows this is near the end.
Introduction.zh: 引言在开头吸引注意。Finally 表示这接近结尾。

Middle.en: The middle is the problem. Here the problem is already solved.
Middle.zh: 中间是问题。这里问题已经解决了。

Conclusion.en: The conclusion says what you LEARNED. This sentence still tells what happened.
Conclusion.zh: 结论说你学到了什么。这句还在讲发生了什么。

questions.qzh:
这是演讲的哪一部分？
“最后，奶奶尝了我的饺子，说它们很完美。”

questions.q:
Which part of a speech is this?
"I learned that making mistakes is part of learning something new."

why.en: It tells what I learned, not the story again. That is the conclusion.
why.zh: 它讲了我学到什么，不是再讲故事，这是总结。

Beginning.en: The beginning tells when and where the story happened.
Beginning.zh: 开头讲故事发生的时间和地点。

Middle.en: The middle is the problem or surprise in the story.
Middle.zh: 中间是故事里的问题或意外。

End.en: The end tells how the story finished. A lesson learned is the conclusion.
End.zh: 结尾讲故事怎样结束。学到的道理是结论。

“我明白了，犯错是学习新东西的一部分。”

subtitle.en: 10 questions, try as often as you like

why.en: Multiply straight across: top × top = 1 × 1 = 1, bottom × bottom = 2 × 4 = 8. So 1/8. (Half of a quarter is an eighth.)
why.zh: 直接横着乘：分子 1 × 1 = 1，分母 2 × 4 = 8。所以是 1/8。（四分之一的一半是八分之一。）

2/8.en: 2/8 adds the tops (1 + 1). The tops must be MULTIPLIED: 1 × 1 = 1.
2/8.zh: 2/8 是把分子相加（1 + 1）。分子要相乘：1 × 1 = 1。

2/6.en: Multiply fractions straight across: top × top, bottom × bottom. Never add them.
2/6.zh: 分数相乘直接横着乘：分子乘分子，分母乘分母。不能相加。

1/6.en: 1/6 adds the bottoms (2 + 4). The bottoms must be MULTIPLIED: 2 × 4 = 8.
1/6.zh: 1/6 是把分母相加（2 + 4）。分母要相乘：2 × 4 = 8。

why.en: Top × top = 2 × 1 = 2, bottom × bottom = 3 × 2 = 6, so 2/6. Simplify (÷ 2): 1/3.

3/5.en: Multiply fractions straight across: top × top, bottom × bottom. Never add them.
3/5.zh: 分数相乘直接横着乘：分子乘分子，分母乘分母。不能相加。

2/5.en: 2/5 adds the bottoms (3 + 2). Bottoms must be MULTIPLIED: 3 × 2 = 6.
2/5.zh: 2/5 是把分母相加（3 + 2）。分母要相乘：3 × 2 = 6。

3/6.en: 3/6 adds the tops (2 + 1). Tops must be MULTIPLIED: 2 × 1 = 2.
3/6.zh: 3/6 是把分子相加（2 + 1）。分子要相乘：2 × 1 = 2。

why.en: Top × top = 3 × 4 = 12, bottom × bottom = 4 × 5 = 20, so 12/20. Simplify (÷ 4): 3/5.

7/9.en: Multiply fractions straight across: top × top, bottom × bottom. Never add them.
7/9.zh: 分数相乘直接横着乘：分子乘分子，分母乘分母。不能相加。

4/5.en: 4/5 is just the second fraction. You must multiply BOTH fractions.
4/5.zh: 4/5 只是第二个分数。两个分数都要乘。

12/9.en: 12/9 multiplies the tops but ADDS the bottoms (4 + 5). Bottoms must be multiplied: 20.
12/9.zh: 12/9 分子乘了，分母却加了（4 + 5）。分母要相乘：20。

5/3.en: 5/3 adds 4 + 1. A whole number times a fraction multiplies the top: 4 × 1 = 4.
5/3.zh: 5/3 是 4 + 1。整数乘分数要乘分子：4 × 1 = 4。

1/12.en: 1/12 multiplies the BOTTOM by 4. 4 = 4/1, so the 4 multiplies the top.
1/12.zh: 1/12 是把分母乘了 4。4 = 4/1，所以 4 乘的是分子。

4/12.en: 4/12 multiplies the top AND the bottom by 4, which keeps the same value (1/3). Only the top gets × 4.
4/12.zh: 4/12 是分子分母都乘 4，值没变（1/3）。只有分子乘 4。

why.en: Top × top = 5 × 2 = 10, bottom × bottom = 6 × 5 = 30, so 10/30. Simplify (÷ 10): 1/3.

10/11.en: 10/11 multiplies the tops but ADDS the bottoms (6 + 5). Bottoms must be multiplied: 30.
10/11.zh: 10/11 分子乘了，分母却加了（6 + 5）。分母要相乘：30。

7/11.en: Multiply fractions straight across: top × top, bottom × bottom. Never add them.
7/11.zh: 分数相乘直接横着乘：分子乘分子，分母乘分母。不能相加。

7/30.en: 7/30 adds the tops (5 + 2). Tops must be MULTIPLIED: 5 × 2 = 10.

why.en: Keep, Change, Flip: 1/2 ÷ 1/4 = 1/2 × 4/1 = 4/2 = 2. Check: how many quarters fit in a half? 2.
why.zh: Keep、Change、Flip：1/2 ÷ 1/4 = 1/2 × 4/1 = 4/2 = 2。检查：半个里面有几个四分之一？2 个。

2/8.en: Dividing by a fraction smaller than 1 makes the answer BIGGER than 1/2. 2/8 is smaller. To divide by a fraction, KEEP the first, CHANGE ÷ to ×, FLIP the second (Keep, Change, Flip).
2/8.zh: 除以小于 1 的分数，答案会比 1/2 大。2/8 更小了。除以一个分数：第一个不变，÷ 变 ×，第二个倒过来（Keep、Change、Flip）。

1/2.en: 1/2 is the number we started with. Dividing by 1/4 changes it.
1/2.zh: 1/2 是开始的数。除以 1/4 会改变它。

1/8.en: 1/8 is 1/2 × 1/4: it multiplied without flipping. To divide by a fraction, KEEP the first, CHANGE ÷ to ×, FLIP the second (Keep, Change, Flip).
1/8.zh: 1/8 是 1/2 × 1/4，没有倒过来就乘了。除以一个分数：第一个不变，÷ 变 ×，第二个倒过来（Keep、Change、Flip）。

why.en: Keep, Change, Flip: 2 ÷ 1/3 = 2 × 3/1 = 6. Check: each whole has 3 thirds, so 2 wholes have 6 thirds.
why.zh: Keep、Change、Flip：2 ÷ 1/3 = 2 × 3/1 = 6。检查：每个整体有 3 个三分之一，2 个整体有 6 个。

2/3.en: 2/3 is 2 × 1/3: it multiplied without flipping. To divide by a fraction, KEEP the first, CHANGE ÷ to ×, FLIP the second (Keep, Change, Flip).
2/3.zh: 2/3 是 2 × 1/3，没有倒过来就乘了。除以一个分数：第一个不变，÷ 变 ×，第二个倒过来（Keep、Change、Flip）。

3/2.en: 3/2 flips the WRONG number. Keep the 2, flip the 1/3 to 3/1.
3/2.zh: 3/2 倒错了数。2 不变，把 1/3 倒成 3/1。

1/6.en: 1/6 is the right digits upside down. Dividing by 1/3 gives MORE than 2, not less.
1/6.zh: 1/6 是把正确答案倒过来了。除以 1/3 结果比 2 大，不是更小。

why.en: Write 3 as 3/1 and flip it: 3/5 × 1/3 = 3/15. Simplify (÷ 3): 1/5. (Sharing 3 fifths between 3 gives 1 fifth each.)
why.zh: 把 3 写成 3/1 再倒过来：3/5 × 1/3 = 3/15。约分（÷ 3）：1/5。（3 个五分之一分给 3 个人，每人 1 个五分之一。）

1/15.en: 1/15 divides the top by 3 AND multiplies the bottom by 3, which divides twice. Only one change is needed: 3/15 = 1/5.
1/15.zh: 1/15 是分子除以 3、分母又乘 3，等于除了两次。只要变一次：3/15 = 1/5。

1 4/5.en: 1 4/5 = 9/5, which is 3/5 × 3: it multiplied instead of dividing.

9/5.en: 9/5 is 3/5 × 3: it multiplied instead of dividing.

why.en: Keep, Change, Flip: 3/4 × 8/3 = 24/12 = 2. Check: 3/8 fits into 3/4 two times (3/8 + 3/8 = 6/8 = 3/4).

9/32.en: 9/32 is 3/4 × 3/8: it multiplied without flipping. To divide by a fraction, KEEP the first, CHANGE ÷ to ×, FLIP the second (Keep, Change, Flip).
9/32.zh: 9/32 是 3/4 × 3/8，没倒过来就乘了。除以一个分数：第一个不变，÷ 变 ×，第二个倒过来（Keep、Change、Flip）。

1/2.en: 1/2 flips the FIRST fraction (4/3 × 3/8). Keep the first, flip the SECOND.
1/2.zh: 1/2 是倒了第一个分数（4/3 × 3/8）。第一个不变，倒第二个。

why.en: Keep, Change, Flip: 4/5 × 3/2 = 12/10 = 6/5 = 1 1/5. Check: dividing by 2/3 (less than 1) makes the answer BIGGER than 4/5.
why.zh: Keep、Change、Flip：4/5 × 3/2 = 12/10 = 6/5 = 1 1/5。检查：除以 2/3（小于 1）会让答案比 4/5 大。

8/15.en: 8/15 is 4/5 × 2/3: it multiplied without flipping. To divide by a fraction, KEEP the first, CHANGE ÷ to ×, FLIP the second (Keep, Change, Flip).
8/15.zh: 8/15 是 4/5 × 2/3，没倒过来就乘了。除以一个分数：第一个不变，÷ 变 ×，第二个倒过来（Keep、Change、Flip）。

2/3.en: 2/3 is just the second fraction, not the answer.
2/3.zh: 2/3 只是第二个分数，不是答案。

6/10.en: 6/10 is smaller than 4/5, but dividing by 2/3 must give a BIGGER answer. 12/10 was halved by mistake.
6/10.zh: 6/10 比 4/5 小，但除以 2/3 答案一定更大。是把 12/10 错误地减半了。

canNow.en: I can now multiply and divide fractions.
canNow.zh: 我现在会分数乘除法。

why.zh: 线索：她吃了三碗面。

very tired.en: Swimming can make you tired, but the clue is that she ATE three bowls. That shows hunger.
very tired.zh: 游泳会累，但线索是她吃了三碗，说明是饿。

very cold.en: Being cold does not explain eating three bowls of noodles.
very cold.zh: 冷不能解释吃了三碗面。

very happy.en: The clue is about food, not about feelings.
very happy.zh: 线索是关于吃的，不是感受。

questions.qzh:
游了两个小时泳后，Lily 感到 FAMISHED。她吃了三碗面！
FAMISHED 的意思是……

questions.q:
Tom is usually TIMID, but on stage he was brave and loud.
TIMID means...

why.en: Clue word "but": timid is the opposite of brave and loud.
why.zh: 线索词 but：timid 和 brave、loud 相反。

very loud.en: "But" shows an OPPOSITE. On stage he was loud, so usually he is the opposite: quiet and shy.
very loud.zh: but 表示相反。他在台上很大声，所以平时正相反：安静害羞。

very tall.en: Height has nothing to do with being brave or loud.
very tall.zh: 身高跟勇敢或大声无关。

angry.en: The opposite of brave is scared, not angry.
angry.zh: 勇敢的反义是害怕，不是生气。

questions.qzh:
Tom 平时很 TIMID，但在台上他又勇敢又大声。
TIMID 的意思是……

questions.q:
Emma loves STATIONERY, such as gel pens, stickers and notebooks.
STATIONERY means...

why.en: Clue words "such as" give examples: pens, stickers, notebooks.
why.zh: 线索词 such as 后面是例子：笔、贴纸、本子。

clothes.en: Pens, stickers and notebooks are not clothes.
clothes.zh: 笔、贴纸和本子不是衣服。

snacks.en: You cannot eat pens and stickers.

toys for babies.en: Gel pens and notebooks are for writing and school, not babies.
toys for babies.zh: 中性笔和本子是写字上学用的，不是给婴儿的。

questions.qzh:
Emma 很喜欢 STATIONERY，比如中性笔、贴纸和笔记本。
STATIONERY 的意思是……

questions.q:
The singer's voice was so FAINT that we could hardly hear it.
FAINT means...

why.en: Clue: we could hardly hear it.
why.zh: 线索：我们几乎听不见。

very loud.en: If it were loud, we could hear it easily. "Hardly hear" means quiet.
very loud.zh: 如果很大声，就很容易听到。hardly hear 表示很小声。

very high.en: A high voice can still be easy to hear. The clue is about how hard it was to hear.
very high.zh: 高音也可以很容易听到。线索是很难听见。

very fast.en: Speed is not the clue. We could hardly HEAR it, so it was quiet.
very fast.zh: 线索不是速度。几乎听不见，所以是小声。

questions.qzh:
歌手的声音太 FAINT 了，我们几乎听不见。
FAINT 的意思是……

questions.q:
The puppy was RAVENOUS, so it gobbled up all its food in seconds.
RAVENOUS means...

why.en: Clue: it gobbled up its food in seconds.
why.zh: 线索：它几秒钟就把食物吃光了。

very sleepy.en: A sleepy puppy would not gobble food in seconds.
very sleepy.zh: 困的小狗不会几秒钟就把饭吃光。

frightened.en: A scared puppy usually hides; eating fast shows hunger.
frightened.zh: 害怕的小狗通常会躲起来；吃得快表示饿。

dirty.en: Being dirty does not explain eating so fast.
dirty.zh: 脏不能解释吃得这么快。

questions.qzh:
小狗很 RAVENOUS，几秒钟就把饭吃光了。
RAVENOUS 的意思是……

questions.q:
Unlike her TIDY sister, Sophie had a very messy room.
TIDY means...

why.en: Clue word "unlike": tidy is the opposite of messy.
why.zh: 线索词 unlike：tidy 和 messy 相反。

messy.en: "Unlike" shows an OPPOSITE. Sophie is messy, so her sister is the opposite.
messy.zh: unlike 表示相反。Sophie 很乱，所以她姐姐正相反。

noisy.en: The clue compares rooms (messy), not sound.
noisy.zh: 线索比较的是房间（乱），不是声音。

small.en: The opposite of messy is neat, not small.
small.zh: 乱的反义是整齐，不是小。

questions.qzh:
和她 TIDY 的姐姐不一样，Sophie 的房间很乱。
TIDY 的意思是……

questions.q:
At the festival, the streets were PACKED. There was no room to move.
PACKED means...

why.en: Clue: there was no room to move.
why.zh: 线索：没有地方可以动。

empty.en: Empty streets would have lots of room. "No room to move" means full.
empty.zh: 空的街道会有很多空间。no room to move 表示很满。

wet.en: Wet is about water. The clue is about having no room.
wet.zh: wet 跟水有关。线索是没有空间。

quiet.en: A crowded festival is usually noisy, and the clue is about space.
quiet.zh: 拥挤的节日通常很吵，线索讲的是空间。

questions.qzh:
节日的时候，街上很 PACKED，挤得动不了。
PACKED 的意思是……

questions.q:
James was ELATED when his team won the swimming gala. He jumped and cheered.
ELATED means...

why.en: Clue: he jumped and cheered.
why.zh: 线索：他跳起来欢呼。

very sad.en: People who are sad do not jump and cheer.
very sad.zh: 难过的人不会跳起来欢呼。

bored.en: Jumping and cheering shows strong excitement, not boredom.
bored.zh: 跳起来欢呼是非常兴奋，不是无聊。

worried.en: His team WON, and he cheered, so he was not worried.
worried.zh: 他的队赢了，他在欢呼，所以不担心。

questions.qzh:
James 的队赢了游泳比赛，他很 ELATED，又跳又欢呼。
ELATED 的意思是……

questions.q:
The old map was FRAGILE, so we held it carefully so it would not tear.
FRAGILE means...

why.en: Clue: held it carefully so it would not tear.
why.zh: 线索：小心拿着，免得撕破。

very heavy.en: Heavy things are not easy to tear. You hold it carefully because it could break.
very heavy.zh: 重的东西不容易撕破。小心拿着是因为它容易坏。

brand new.en: New maps are strong. The clue says it is OLD and might tear.
brand new.zh: 新地图很结实。线索说它很旧，容易撕破。

colourful.en: Colour has nothing to do with tearing.

questions.qzh:
这张旧地图很 FRAGILE，我们小心地拿着，免得撕破。
FRAGILE 的意思是……

questions.q: Which clue word tells you that an OPPOSITE is coming?

why.en: But and unlike = opposite. Such as and for example = examples. Which means = the meaning.
why.zh: but、unlike = 相反；such as、for example = 举例；which means = 意思。

such as.zh: such as 引出例子（笔、贴纸）。

which means.zh: which means 直接给出意思。

questions.qzh: 哪个线索词告诉你后面要说相反的意思？

canNow.en: I can now work out new words from context clues.
canNow.zh: 我现在会用上下文线索猜词义。

intro.en: Read the sentence, then tap the best joining word.
intro.zh: 读句子，然后点出最合适的连词。

items.text: Emma ___ Sophie both love K-pop.

why.en: Both ... and: it adds them together.
why.zh: both ... and：把两个人加在一起。

items.textzh: Emma ___ Sophie 都喜欢 K-pop。

items.text: Daisy wanted to swim, ___ the pool was closed.

why.en: Something different from what she wanted: but.
why.zh: 和她想要的不一样：but。

items.textzh: Daisy 想去游泳，___ 游泳池关门了。

items.text: You can pick the red pen ___ the blue pen, but not both.

why.en: A choice: or.
why.zh: 选择：or。

items.textzh: 你可以选红笔 ___ 蓝笔，但不能两支都要。

items.text: It started to rain, ___ we ran inside.

why.en: Running inside is the result: so.
why.zh: 跑进屋是结果：so。

items.textzh: 开始下雨了，___ 我们跑进了屋里。

items.text: Tom was hungry ___ he did not eat breakfast.

why.en: It gives the reason: because.
why.zh: 说原因：because。

items.textzh: Tom 很饿，___ 他没吃早饭。

items.text: ___ it was raining, we still went to the festival.

why.en: A surprise: even though it rained, we went.
why.zh: 意外：虽然下雨，我们还是去了。

items.textzh: ___ 在下雨，我们还是去了节日活动。

items.text: You will get a sticker ___ you finish your work.

why.en: A condition: if.
why.zh: 条件：if。

items.textzh: ___ 你做完作业，你就会得到一张贴纸。

items.text: We waited at the bus stop ___ the bus came.

why.en: We waited up to that time: until.
why.zh: 一直等到那个时候：until。

items.textzh: 我们在车站等 ___ 公交车来了。

items.text: Wash your hands ___ you eat.

why.en: First wash, then eat: before.
why.zh: 先洗手，再吃饭：before。

items.textzh: 吃饭 ___ 要洗手。

items.text: My phone beeps ___ I get a message.

why.en: It tells you the time it happens: when.
why.zh: 说明什么时候发生：when。

items.textzh: ___ 我收到信息，我的手机就会响。

canNow.en: I can now choose the right conjunction.
canNow.zh: 我现在会选对连词。

intro.en: Tap the meaning, then tap the person word.
intro.zh: 先点意思，再点表示人的词。

pairs.a: a person who operates a machine

canNow.en: I can now spell -er and -or person words.
canNow.zh: 我现在会拼写以 -er 和 -or 结尾的表示人的词。

intro.en: Top × top, bottom × bottom, then simplify.
intro.zh: 分子乘分子，分母乘分母，再约分。

why.en: Top × top: 1 × 1 = 1. Bottom × bottom: 2 × 3 = 6. So 1/6.
why.zh: 分子乘分子：1 × 1 = 1；分母乘分母：2 × 3 = 6。所以是 1/6。

2/5.en: Multiply fractions straight across: top × top, bottom × bottom. Never add them.
2/5.zh: 分数相乘直接横着乘：分子乘分子，分母乘分母。不能相加。

2/6.en: 2/6 adds the tops (1 + 1). Tops must be multiplied: 1 × 1 = 1.

1/5.en: 1/5 adds the bottoms (2 + 3). Bottoms must be multiplied: 2 × 3 = 6.

5/7.en: Multiply fractions straight across: top × top, bottom × bottom. Never add them.
5/7.zh: 分数相乘直接横着乘：分子乘分子，分母乘分母。不能相加。

6/7.en: 6/7 multiplies the tops but ADDS the bottoms (3 + 4). Bottoms must be multiplied: 12.
6/7.zh: 6/7 分子乘了，分母却加了（3 + 4）。分母要相乘：12。

5/12.en: 5/12 adds the tops (2 + 3). Tops must be multiplied: 2 × 3 = 6.

6/10.en: 6/10 multiplies the bottom by 2 as well. 2 = 2/1, so the bottom is × 1: 6/5.

3/10.en: 3/10 multiplies only the BOTTOM by 2. The 2 multiplies the top.
3/10.zh: 3/10 只把分母乘了 2。2 应该乘分子。

4/32.en: 4/32 multiplies the bottom by 4. 4 = 4/1, so only the top is × 4: 4/8.

1/32.en: 1/32 multiplies the bottom by 4 instead of the top.
1/32.zh: 1/32 把 4 乘到分母上了，应该乘分子。

7/11.en: Multiply fractions straight across: top × top, bottom × bottom. Never add them.
7/11.zh: 分数相乘直接横着乘：分子乘分子，分母乘分母。不能相加。

10/11.en: 10/11 multiplies the tops but ADDS the bottoms (5 + 6). Bottoms must be multiplied: 30.
10/11.zh: 10/11 分子乘了，分母却加了（5 + 6）。分母要相乘：30。

7/30.en: 7/30 adds the tops (2 + 5). Tops must be multiplied: 2 × 5 = 10.

questions.q: Lily drinks 3/4 of a 1/2 litre bottle of juice. How much does she drink?

4/6 L.en: 4/6 adds the tops and the bottoms. "Of" means MULTIPLY.
4/6 L.zh: 4/6 是分子分母都相加了。of 表示乘。

5/4 L.en: 5/4 is 3/4 + 1/2, adding. She drinks PART of half a litre, so it must be less than 1/2 L.
5/4 L.zh: 5/4 是 3/4 + 1/2，加了。她只喝了半升的一部分，一定少于 1/2 升。

questions.qzh: Lily 喝了一瓶 1/2 升果汁的 3/4。她喝了多少？

questions.q: What is 2/3 of 9 stickers?

why.en: 2/3 × 9: 9 ÷ 3 = 3, then 3 × 2 = 6 stickers.

3 stickers.en: 3 is only 1/3 of 9. We need 2 thirds: 3 × 2 = 6.
3 stickers.zh: 3 只是 9 的 1/3。我们要 2 个三分之一：3 × 2 = 6。

18 stickers.en: 18 is 2 × 9, which forgets to divide by 3. A fraction of 9 must be LESS than 9.
18 stickers.zh: 18 是 2 × 9，忘了除以 3。9 的几分之几一定比 9 小。

27 stickers.en: 27 is 3 × 9. A fraction of 9 stickers must be less than 9.
27 stickers.zh: 27 是 3 × 9。9 张的几分之几一定少于 9 张。

questions.qzh: 9 张贴纸的 2/3 是多少？

questions.q: How do you multiply two fractions?

why.en: Multiply straight across. No common denominator needed. Flipping is for DIVIDING.
why.zh: 直接横着乘，不用通分。倒过来是除法才用的。

add the tops.en: Adding is for adding fractions. For multiplying, MULTIPLY the tops and the bottoms.
add the tops.zh: 相加是分数加法用的。乘法要分子乘分子、分母乘分母。

find a common denominator first.en: Common denominators are needed for ADDING and SUBTRACTING, not multiplying.
find a common denominator first.zh: 通分是加法和减法才需要的，乘法不需要。

flip the second fraction.en: Flipping is for DIVIDING (Keep, Change, Flip), not multiplying.
flip the second fraction.zh: 倒过来是除法用的（Keep、Change、Flip），不是乘法。

questions.qzh: 两个分数怎样相乘？

ozh.top × top, bottom × bottom: 分子乘分子，分母乘分母

canNow.en: I can now multiply fractions and simplify the answer.
canNow.zh: 我现在会做分数乘法并约分。

subtitle.en: 12 questions, try as often as you like

intro.en: Read each question twice. You can try again as many times as you like. Then look at every answer in 📋 Homework Review.
intro.zh: 每道题读两遍。可以做很多次。然后在“📋 作业讲评”里看每道题的答案。

questions.q: "The kitten was so DROWSY that it fell asleep in my lap." DROWSY means...

why.en: Clue: it fell asleep.
why.zh: 线索：它睡着了。

hungry.en: The clue is "fell asleep", not eating.
hungry.zh: 线索是 fell asleep（睡着了），不是吃。

noisy.en: A noisy kitten would not fall asleep quietly in your lap.
noisy.zh: 吵闹的小猫不会安静地在腿上睡着。

brave.en: Brave is about not being afraid; the clue is about sleep.
brave.zh: brave 是不害怕；线索是关于睡觉的。

questions.qzh: “小猫太 DROWSY 了，在我腿上睡着了。”DROWSY 的意思是……

questions.q: "Unlike the CALM lake, the sea was wild and stormy." CALM means...

why.en: Clue word "unlike": calm is the opposite of wild and stormy.
why.zh: 线索词 unlike：calm 和 wild、stormy 相反。

wild.en: "Unlike" shows an OPPOSITE. The sea was wild, so the lake was the opposite.
wild.zh: unlike 表示相反。海很狂暴，所以湖正相反。

deep.en: The clue compares wild and stormy, not depth.
deep.zh: 线索比较的是狂暴，不是深浅。

cold.en: The opposite of stormy is still and peaceful, not cold.
cold.zh: 暴风雨的反义是平静，不是冷。

questions.qzh: “和 CALM 的湖不一样，大海又狂暴又有风暴。”CALM 的意思是……

questions.q: "We ate lots of DESSERTS, such as ice cream, mango sticky rice and cake." DESSERTS are...

why.en: Clue words "such as": ice cream, cake. All sweet foods.
why.zh: 线索词 such as：冰淇淋、蛋糕，都是甜食。

drinks.en: Ice cream, mango sticky rice and cake are foods, not drinks.
drinks.zh: 冰淇淋、芒果糯米饭和蛋糕是食物，不是饮料。

vegetables.en: The examples are all SWEET foods, not vegetables.
vegetables.zh: 例子都是甜食，不是蔬菜。

breakfast foods.en: Cake and ice cream come after a meal, not at breakfast.
breakfast foods.zh: 蛋糕和冰淇淋是饭后吃的，不是早餐。

questions.qzh: “我们吃了很多 DESSERTS，比如冰淇淋、芒果糯米饭和蛋糕。”DESSERTS 是……

questions.q: "I was tired, ___ I went to bed early."

why.en: "So" shows a RESULT: being tired is the reason, going to bed early is what happened because of it.
why.zh: so 表示结果：累是原因，早睡是因此发生的事。

but.en: "But" shows a CONTRAST (something unexpected). Going to bed when tired is expected.
but.zh: but 表示转折（意料之外）。累了去睡觉是意料之中的。

or.en: "Or" gives a CHOICE between two things.
or.zh: or 是在两样里选一样。

until.en: "Until" is about time (up to a point). "I was tired, until I went to bed" does not make sense.
until.zh: until 表示时间（直到）。I was tired, until I went to bed 说不通。

questions.qzh: “我很累，___ 我早早睡了。”（选连接词）

questions.q: "Do you want to swim ___ play badminton?"

why.en: "Or" joins two CHOICES: swim, or play badminton.
why.zh: or 连接两个选择：游泳还是打羽毛球。

so.en: "So" shows a result, not a choice.
so.zh: so 表示结果，不是选择。

because.en: "Because" gives a reason, not a choice.
because.zh: because 给出原因，不是选择。

although.en: "Although" shows a contrast, not a choice.
although.zh: although 表示让步，不是选择。

questions.qzh: “你想游泳 ___ 打羽毛球？”（选连接词）

questions.q: Which sentence has the comma in the right place?
options: I love K-pop so, I bought a photo card.
I love, K-pop so I bought a photo card.
I love K-pop, so I bought a photo card.
I love K-pop so I, bought a photo card.

why.en: Two full sentences joined by so: the comma goes BEFORE so.
why.zh: 两个完整句子用 so 连接：逗号放在 so 前面。

I love K-pop so, I bought a photo card..en: The comma goes BEFORE the joining word, not after it.
I love K-pop so, I bought a photo card..zh: 逗号放在连接词前面，不是后面。

I love, K-pop so I bought a photo card..en: This comma splits "love" from what she loves. It belongs before "so".
I love, K-pop so I bought a photo card..zh: 这个逗号把 love 和她爱的东西分开了。逗号应该在 so 前面。

I love K-pop so I, bought a photo card..en: This comma splits "I" from its verb "bought". It belongs before "so".
I love K-pop so I, bought a photo card..zh: 这个逗号把 I 和它的动词 bought 分开了。逗号应该在 so 前面。

questions.qzh: 哪一句的逗号位置正确？

questions.q: A person who acts in films is an...

why.en: Act ends in -ct, so add -or: actor.
why.zh: act 以 -ct 结尾，加 -or：actor。

acter.en: Words ending in -ct (act, direct, conduct) take -OR for the person: actor.
acter.zh: 以 -ct 结尾的词（act、direct、conduct）表示人时加 -or：actor。

actour.en: The ending is -or, with no u (in British spelling only words like colour have -our).

actar.en: The ending for a person who acts is -or, not -ar.
actar.zh: 表示演员的词尾是 -or，不是 -ar。

questions.qzh: 在电影里演戏的人是……（选正确的拼写）

questions.q: A person who swims is a...

why.en: Short vowel + one m: double the m, then add -er.
why.zh: 短元音加一个 m：双写 m，再加 -er。

swimer.en: Swim has a SHORT vowel (i) and ends in one consonant (m), so double the m before -er: swimmer.
swimer.zh: swim 是短元音（i）加一个辅音（m），加 -er 前要双写 m：swimmer。

swimor.en: A person who swims takes -er, and the m must be doubled: swimmer.
swimor.zh: 游泳的人用 -er，m 还要双写：swimmer。

swimmor.en: The double m is right, but the ending is -er, not -or.
swimmor.zh: 双写 m 对了，但词尾是 -er，不是 -or。

questions.qzh: 游泳的人是……（选正确的拼写）

questions.q: "Emma went out on a limb and told the class her own idea." This means Emma...

why.en: Go out on a limb = take a risk by saying something others may not agree with.
why.zh: go out on a limb = 冒险说别人可能不同意的话。

climbed a tree.en: A limb is a branch, but this is an IDIOM: its meaning is different from the words.
climbed a tree.zh: limb 是树枝，但这是习语：意思和字面不一样。

broke her arm.en: Limb can mean arm or leg, but the idiom is about taking a risk, not getting hurt.
broke her arm.zh: limb 也可以指手臂或腿，但这个习语是冒险，不是受伤。

left the room.en: She "told the class her idea", so she stayed. Going out on a limb means being brave with an idea.
left the room.zh: 她 told the class her idea，所以她没离开。go out on a limb 是勇敢地说出想法。

questions.qzh: “Emma went out on a limb，在全班面前说出了自己的想法。”这表示 Emma……

why.en: Multiply straight across: 3 × 2 = 6 and 4 × 3 = 12, so 6/12. Simplify (÷ 6): 1/2.

5/7.en: Multiply fractions straight across: top × top, bottom × bottom. Never add them.
5/7.zh: 分数相乘直接横着乘：分子乘分子，分母乘分母。不能相加。

6/7.en: 6/7 multiplies the tops but ADDS the bottoms (4 + 3). Bottoms must be multiplied: 12.
6/7.zh: 6/7 分子乘了，分母却加了（4 + 3）。分母要相乘：12。

5/12.en: 5/12 adds the tops (3 + 2). Tops must be multiplied: 6.
5/12.zh: 5/12 是分子相加（3 + 2）。分子要相乘：6。

questions.q: What is 1/4 of 20 sweets?

why.en: 1/4 of 20 means share 20 into 4 equal groups: 20 ÷ 4 = 5 sweets.

4 sweets.en: 4 is the number of groups, not the size of one group.
4 sweets.zh: 4 是份数，不是一份的大小。

80 sweets.en: 80 is 20 × 4. A quarter of 20 must be LESS than 20.
80 sweets.zh: 80 是 20 × 4。20 的四分之一一定比 20 小。

questions.qzh: 20 颗糖的 1/4 是多少？

questions.q: Which spelling is correct?

why.en: Investigate: drop the e, add -ion: investigation.
why.zh: investigate 去掉 e，加 -ion：investigation。

investigasion.en: The "shun" sound here is spelled -tion: investigate → investigation.
investigasion.zh: 这里的 shun 音拼作 -tion：investigate → investigation。

investegation.en: The base word is inves-TI-gate, with an i, not an e.
investegation.zh: 原词是 inves-ti-gate，是 i，不是 e。

investigtion.en: The a from investig-A-te must stay: investig-a-tion.
investigtion.zh: investigate 的 a 要保留：investig-a-tion。

questions.qzh: 哪个拼写是正确的？

canNow.en: I can now use this week's words, joining words and fractions by myself.
canNow.zh: 我现在能自己用本周的词、连词和分数。

intro.en: Learn the key words, read the story, use context clues, then write one sentence.
intro.zh: 先学关键词，再读故事，用上下文线索答题，最后写一句话。

keywords.meaning: keep thinking about your goal and do not give up
you have decided to do something and you will not stop
smiled a very big, happy smile

paragraphs: Emma wanted to swim in the city gala. Her coach said she needed to swim 50 metres in under 40 seconds. Emma was determined. She decided she would practise every morning before school, even when it was cold.

Every day, Emma's arms ached and her legs felt like jelly. By Friday she was exhausted, so tired that she fell asleep on the bus. Her friend Sophie said, "Keep your eyes on the prize. Think about the gala!"
On the day of the gala, the pool was packed with people, and there was no empty seat anywhere. Emma's heart was pounding. The whistle blew and she dived in.
She touched the wall and looked at the clock: 38 seconds! Emma beamed. Her smile was so big that her cheeks hurt. All those cold mornings had been worth it.

questions.q: DETERMINED means...
options: she had decided and would not stop

why.en: Clue: she decided she would practise every morning, even when it was cold.
why.zh: 线索：她决定每天早上练习，即使很冷。

she was scared.en: A scared person might give up. She practised every morning even when it was cold, which shows she would not stop.
she was scared.zh: 害怕的人可能会放弃。她就算天冷也每天早上练习，说明她不会停。

she was bored.en: Bored people do not practise every morning.
she was bored.zh: 无聊的人不会每天早上练习。

she was lost.en: Nothing in the clue is about being lost; it is about deciding and not stopping.
she was lost.zh: 线索里没有迷路的意思，讲的是下定决心、不停下。

questions.qzh: DETERMINED 的意思是……

questions.q: Which words are the context clue for EXHAUSTED?
options: on the day of the gala
so tired that she fell asleep on the bus

why.en: The meaning comes right after: so tired.
why.zh: 意思紧跟在后面：so tired（非常累）。

her friend Sophie.en: This names a person; it does not explain the word.
her friend Sophie.zh: 这是一个人名，没有解释这个词。

on the day of the gala.en: This tells WHEN, not what exhausted means.
on the day of the gala.zh: 这讲的是什么时候，不是 exhausted 的意思。

the whistle blew.en: This is an event in the race, not a clue about being tired.
the whistle blew.zh: 这是比赛里的事，不是累的线索。

questions.qzh: 哪些词是 EXHAUSTED 的上下文线索？

ozh.so tired that she fell asleep on the bus: 累得在公交车上睡着了

questions.q: "The pool was PACKED." Which clue helps?
options: there was no empty seat anywhere

why.en: No empty seat = very full.
why.zh: 没有空座位 = 非常满。

the whistle blew.en: The whistle starts the race; it says nothing about how full the pool was.
the whistle blew.zh: 哨声是比赛开始，跟游泳馆有多满无关。

she dived in.en: Diving in is what she did, not a clue about the crowd.
she dived in.zh: 跳水是她做的事，不是人多的线索。

38 seconds.en: 38 seconds is her time, not a clue about the crowd.
38 seconds.zh: 38 秒是她的成绩，不是人多的线索。

questions.qzh: “泳池很 PACKED。”哪个线索有帮助？

questions.q: What does Sophie mean by "Keep your eyes on the prize"?
options: Think about your goal and do not give up.

why.en: It is an idiom. Sophie wants Emma to remember her goal.
why.zh: 这是习语。Sophie 想让 Emma 记住目标。

Look at the medals..en: This takes the words literally. An idiom means something different: keep thinking about your goal.
Look at the medals..zh: 这是按字面理解。习语的意思不一样：一直想着你的目标。

Close your eyes..en: Keep your eyes ON something is the opposite of closing them, and it is not literal.
Close your eyes..zh: keep your eyes on 跟闭眼正相反，而且不是字面意思。

Buy a prize..en: Nobody is buying anything; it means remembering your goal.
Buy a prize..zh: 没有人在买东西，意思是记住你的目标。

questions.qzh: Sophie 说 Keep your eyes on the prize 是什么意思？

ozh.Think about your goal and do not give up: 想着你的目标，不要放弃。

questions.q: Did Emma reach her goal?

why.en: Her goal was under 40 seconds. 38 is less than 40.
why.zh: 目标是 40 秒以内。38 比 40 少。

No: she was too slow..en: Her goal was UNDER 40 seconds. 38 is less than 40, so she was fast enough.
No: she was too slow..zh: 她的目标是 40 秒以内。38 比 40 少，所以她够快。

No: she did not swim..en: The story says she dived in and swam the race.
No: she did not swim..zh: 故事说她跳下水游了比赛。

We do not know..en: We DO know: the goal (under 40) and her time (38) are both in the story.
We do not know..zh: 我们知道：目标（40 秒以内）和成绩（38 秒）故事里都有。

questions.qzh: Emma 达到目标了吗？

达到了：38 秒在 40 秒以内。

questions.q: Which is the best THEME?
options: Hard work helps you reach your goals.
Pools are cold in the morning.

why.en: A theme is a life lesson for everyone, with no names.
why.zh: 主题是给每个人的道理，不写名字。

Emma swam in a gala..en: This is what HAPPENED, with a name: a summary, not a theme.
Emma swam in a gala..zh: 这是发生的事，有名字：是概要，不是主题。

Pools are cold in the morning..en: This is a small fact, not a life lesson.
Pools are cold in the morning..zh: 这是一个小事实，不是人生道理。

Sophie is Emma's friend..en: This is a fact about the characters, not a lesson.
Sophie is Emma's friend..zh: 这是关于人物的事实，不是道理。

questions.qzh: 哪一个是最好的主题？

Sophie 是 Emma 的朋友。

prompt.en: Write ONE sentence about a goal you have. Use the word "determined".
prompt.zh: 写一句关于你自己目标的话，要用到 determined 这个词。

write.model: I am determined to swim 100 metres without stopping.

canNow.en: I can now use context clues while I read a story.
canNow.zh: 我现在读故事时会用上下文线索。

intro.en: Characters, setting, problem, events, solution: which one is it?
intro.zh: 人物、背景、问题、事件、解决：是哪一个？

questions.q: "Tom and his little sister Lily" are the...

why.en: Who = characters.
why.zh: 谁 = 人物。

setting.en: The setting is WHERE and WHEN, not who.
setting.zh: 背景是在哪里、什么时候，不是谁。

problem.en: The problem is what goes WRONG.

solution.en: The solution is how the problem gets FIXED.
solution.zh: 解决办法是问题怎样被解决。

questions.qzh: “Tom 和他的妹妹 Lily”是故事的……

questions.q: "On a snowy morning in the mountains" is the...

why.en: Where and when = setting.
why.zh: 在哪里、什么时候 = 背景。

characters.en: Characters are WHO is in the story.

solution.en: The solution is how the problem is fixed.
solution.zh: 解决办法是问题怎样被解决。

events.en: Events are what the characters DO, step by step.
events.zh: 事件是人物一步一步做的事。

questions.qzh: “一个下雪的早上，在山里”是故事的……

questions.q: "Their puppy ran away into the forest." This is the...

why.en: Something goes wrong = problem.
why.zh: 出了问题 = 问题。

setting.en: The setting is where and when.
setting.zh: 背景是在哪里、什么时候。

solution.en: The puppy has not been found yet, so nothing is fixed.
solution.zh: 小狗还没找到，所以还没解决。

characters.en: Characters are who is in the story.

questions.qzh: “他们的小狗跑进了森林。”这是故事的……

questions.q: "They followed the paw prints and called his name." These are the...

why.en: What the characters do, step by step = events.
why.zh: 人物一步一步做的事 = 事件。

setting.en: The setting is where and when, not actions.
setting.zh: 背景是在哪里、什么时候，不是动作。

problem.en: The problem was the puppy running away. Following prints is what they DO about it.
problem.zh: 问题是小狗跑了。跟着脚印是他们为此做的事。

theme.en: A theme is a life lesson, not actions.
theme.zh: 主题是人生道理，不是动作。

questions.qzh: “他们跟着爪印走，喊着它的名字。”这些是故事的……

questions.q: "They found the puppy asleep under a tree and carried him home." This is the...

why.en: The problem is fixed = solution.
why.zh: 问题解决了 = 解决。

problem.en: Finding the puppy FIXES the problem.
problem.zh: 找到小狗是解决了问题。

setting.en: The setting is where and when.
setting.zh: 背景是在哪里、什么时候。

characters.en: Characters are who is in the story.

questions.qzh: “他们发现小狗在树下睡着了，就把它抱回了家。”这是故事的……

questions.q: Which sentence SHOWS a feeling best?
options: Her hands shook as she opened the letter.

why.en: Showing (shaking hands) paints a picture. Telling ("scared") does not.
why.zh: “手在发抖”能让人看到画面，只说“害怕”不行。

She was scared..en: This TELLS the feeling with one word. Showing describes what her body does so we can picture it.
She was scared..zh: 这是用一个词直接说出感受。展示是描写她的身体在做什么，让我们想象得到。

She was a girl..en: This gives no feeling at all.

It was Monday..en: This is the time, not a feeling.

questions.qzh: 哪一句最能“展示”出感受？

ozh.Her hands shook as she opened the letter: 她打开信的时候手在发抖。

questions.q: A draft is...
options: a first try that you will improve

why.en: Draft = first try. You check and improve it later.
why.zh: 草稿 = 第一次尝试，之后再检查、修改。

the final perfect copy.en: The final copy comes AFTER drafting and checking.
the final perfect copy.zh: 定稿是在打草稿和检查之后。

a list of spelling words.en: A spelling list is not a piece of writing you improve.
a list of spelling words.zh: 拼写单词表不是要修改的文章。

a picture.en: A draft is writing, not a picture.

questions.qzh: 草稿（draft）是……

ozh.a first try that you will improve: 第一次尝试，之后还会修改

questions.q: Which is a FICTION story?
options: My trip to the dentist yesterday
The life of a real scientist
A dragon who is scared of the dark

why.en: Fiction = made up. Dragons are not real!
why.zh: 虚构 = 编的。龙不是真的！

How to make fried rice.en: Instructions are NON-fiction: real and true.
How to make fried rice.zh: 做法说明是非虚构的：真实的。

My trip to the dentist yesterday.en: A real trip is a true recount: non-fiction.
My trip to the dentist yesterday.zh: 真实的旅程是真事记叙：非虚构。

The life of a real scientist.en: A real person's life is a biography: non-fiction.
The life of a real scientist.zh: 真人的一生是传记：非虚构。

questions.qzh: 哪一个是虚构（fiction）的故事？

ozh.The life of a real scientist: 一位真实科学家的一生

canNow.en: I can now name the 5 parts of a story.
canNow.zh: 我现在能说出故事的 5 个部分。

title.zh: 星期六作业：分数应用题

subtitle.en: 10 questions, try as often as you like

intro.en: Look for the key words: "of" and "each day" mean ×, "how many in" and "share" mean ÷. You can try again as many times as you like.
intro.zh: 找关键词：of 和“每天”是 ×，“……里有几个”和“平均分”是 ÷。可以做很多次。

questions.q: Lily has 3/4 of a pizza. She eats 1/3 of it. What fraction of the WHOLE pizza does she eat?

4/7.en: Multiply fractions straight across: top × top, bottom × bottom. Never add them.
4/7.zh: 分数相乘直接横着乘：分子乘分子，分母乘分母。不能相加。

3/7.en: 3/7 adds the bottoms (4 + 3). Bottoms must be multiplied: 12.
3/7.zh: 3/7 是分母相加（4 + 3）。分母要相乘：12。

1 1/4.en: 1 1/4 is MORE than a whole pizza, but she only had 3/4. She eats part of what she had, so it must be less than 3/4.
1 1/4.zh: 1 1/4 比一整个披萨还多，但她只有 3/4。她吃的是一部分，一定少于 3/4。

questions.qzh: Lily 有 3/4 个披萨，她吃了其中的 1/3。她吃了整个披萨的几分之几？

questions.q: Tom has 4 m of ribbon. Each bow needs 1/2 m. How many bows can he make?

why.en: How many ... in ... = divide: 4 ÷ 1/2 = 4 × 2 = 8 bows.

2.en: 2 is 4 × 1/2: it multiplied. "How many halves in 4?" means divide: 4 ÷ 1/2 = 8.

4 1/2.en: 4 1/2 is 4 + 1/2: adding. Each metre makes 2 bows, so 4 metres make 8.
4 1/2.zh: 4 1/2 是 4 + 1/2，加了。每米做 2 个蝴蝶结，4 米做 8 个。

6.en: Check: 6 bows × 1/2 m = 3 m, but he has 4 m. 8 × 1/2 = 4 ✓.

questions.qzh: Tom 有 4 米丝带，每个蝴蝶结要 1/2 米。他能做几个蝴蝶结？

questions.q: Emma swims 2/5 km every day. How far does she swim in 5 days?

why.en: The same amount every day means MULTIPLY: 2/5 × 5 = 10/5 = 2 km.
why.zh: 每天一样多就用乘法：2/5 × 5 = 10/5 = 2 公里。

2/25 km.en: 2/25 multiplies the BOTTOM by 5. 5 = 5/1, so the 5 multiplies the top: 10/5.
2/25 km.zh: 2/25 是把分母乘了 5。5 = 5/1，所以 5 乘的是分子：10/5。

7/5 km.en: 7/5 adds 5 to the top (2 + 5). The 5 days MULTIPLY: 2 × 5 = 10.

10 km.en: 10 is 2 × 5 but forgets the bottom: 10/5 = 2. She swims less than 1 km a day, so 5 days must be less than 5 km.
10 km.zh: 10 是 2 × 5，但忘了分母：10/5 = 2。她每天不到 1 公里，5 天一定不到 5 公里。

questions.qzh: Emma 每天游 2/5 公里。她 5 天游多远？

questions.q: 3 friends share 3/4 kg of sweets equally. How much does each get?

why.en: Shared equally = DIVIDE: 3/4 ÷ 3 = 3/4 × 1/3 = 3/12 = 1/4 kg each.

9/4 kg.en: 9/4 is 3/4 × 3: it multiplied. Sharing makes each part SMALLER, so divide.
9/4 kg.zh: 9/4 是 3/4 × 3，乘了。分东西每份会变小，要用除法。

1/3 kg.en: 1/3 is "one of three people", not the amount. Check: 3 × 1/3 = 1 kg, but there is only 3/4 kg.
1/3 kg.zh: 1/3 是“三个人中的一个”，不是数量。检查：3 × 1/3 = 1 千克，但只有 3/4 千克。

1 kg.en: 1 kg is MORE than all the sweets (3/4 kg). Each share must be smaller than the whole.
1 kg.zh: 1 千克比全部糖果（3/4 千克）还多。每份一定比总数小。

questions.qzh: 3 个朋友平分 3/4 千克糖果。每人分到多少？

questions.q: Sophie has 200 baht. She spends 3/4 of it on a phone case. How much does she spend?

why.en: 3/4 of 200: first find 1/4: 200 ÷ 4 = 50. Then 3 quarters: 50 × 3 = 150 baht.

50 baht.zh: 50 只是 1/4。她花了 3 个四分之一：50 × 3。

75 baht.en: Check: 75 is only 3/8 of 200. 3/4 of 200 is 150.

800 baht.en: 800 is 200 × 4. She cannot spend more than the 200 baht she has.
800 baht.zh: 800 是 200 × 4。她不可能花得比她有的 200 泰铢还多。

questions.qzh: Sophie 有 200 泰铢，她把其中的 3/4 用来买手机壳。她花了多少钱？

questions.q: A bottle holds 2 litres. Each glass holds 1/4 litre. How many glasses can you fill?

why.en: "How many 1/4 in 2?" = divide: 2 ÷ 1/4 = 2 × 4 = 8 glasses. (Each litre fills 4 glasses.)

1/2.en: 1/2 is 2 × 1/4: it multiplied. You cannot fill half a glass as the answer to "how many glasses".
1/2.zh: 1/2 是 2 × 1/4，乘了。“能装几杯”不会是半杯。

6.en: Check: 6 × 1/4 = 1 1/2 litres, but the bottle has 2 litres.

4.en: 4 glasses is only 1 litre (4 × 1/4). There are 2 litres.
4.zh: 4 杯只有 1 升（4 × 1/4）。这里有 2 升。

questions.qzh: 一个瓶子装 2 升，每个杯子装 1/4 升。能装满几杯？

questions.q: Which word problem needs DIVIDING?
options: How many 1/3 cups are in 2 cups?
She runs 1/4 km each day for 3 days.

why.en: "How many ... in ..." = divide. "Of" and "each day for" = multiply.
why.zh: “……里有几个” = 除法；of 和“每天……共几天” = 乘法。

She runs 1/4 km each day for 3 days..en: The same amount each day for 3 days means MULTIPLY: 1/4 × 3.

questions.qzh: 哪一道应用题要用除法？

她每天跑 1/4 公里，跑了 3 天。

why.en: Change to improper fractions, then Keep, Change, Flip: 1/2 × 4/1 = 2.
why.zh: 先变成假分数，再 Keep、Change、Flip：1/2 × 4/1 = 2。

1/8.en: 1/8 is 1/2 × 1/4: it multiplied without flipping. Keep, Change, Flip.
1/8.zh: 1/8 是 1/2 × 1/4，没有倒过来就乘了。要 Keep、Change、Flip。

1/2.en: 1/2 flips the FIRST number. Keep the first, flip the second.
1/2.zh: 1/2 是倒了第一个数。第一个不变，倒第二个。

why.en: Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 2/3 × 3/8. Multiply tops and bottoms: 6/24 = 1/4.
why.zh: 先把带分数变成假分数：2/3 × 3/8。分子乘分子、分母乘分母：6/24 = 1/4。

5/11.en: 5/11 is too big. Change to improper fractions and multiply: 2/3 × 3/8 = 1/4, not 5/11.

6/11.en: 6/11 is too big. Change to improper fractions and multiply: 2/3 × 3/8 = 1/4, not 6/11.

1/3.en: 1/3 is too big. Change to improper fractions and multiply: 2/3 × 3/8 = 1/4, not 1/3.

questions.q: Does the answer make sense? James eats 1/2 of 1/2 of a cake. He says he ate 1 whole cake.
options: No: 1/2 of 1/2 is 1/4, less than half

why.en: Of means ×: 1/2 × 1/2 = 1/4. Half of a half must be smaller than a half.
why.zh: of 就是 ×：1/2 × 1/2 = 1/4。一半的一半一定比一半小。

Yes: 1/2 + 1/2 = 1.en: "Of" means MULTIPLY, not add: 1/2 × 1/2 = 1/4. Half of a half is a quarter, smaller than half.
Yes: 1/2 + 1/2 = 1.zh: of 表示乘，不是加：1/2 × 1/2 = 1/4。一半的一半是四分之一，比一半还小。

questions.qzh: 这个答案合理吗？James 吃了一个蛋糕的 1/2 的 1/2。他说他吃了一整个蛋糕。

ozh.No: 1/2 of 1/2 is 1/4, less than half: 不合理：1/2 的 1/2 是 1/4，比一半还少

canNow.en: I can now choose × or ÷ in fraction word problems.
canNow.zh: 我现在会在分数应用题里选 × 或 ÷。

subtitle.en: 10 questions, try as often as you like

intro.en: Context clues, joining words, -er and -or, story parts and fractions. You can try again as many times as you like.
intro.zh: 上下文线索、连词、-er 和 -or、故事部分和分数。可以做很多次。

questions.q: "The library was SILENT, so quiet that I could hear the clock." SILENT means...

why.en: Clue: so quiet.
why.zh: 线索：so quiet。

very busy.en: A busy library is noisy. The clue says it was "so quiet".
very busy.zh: 热闹的图书馆会很吵。线索说 so quiet。

very dark.en: The clue is about sound (hearing the clock), not light.
very dark.zh: 线索是声音（听到钟声），不是光线。

very cold.en: The clue is about how quiet it was, not temperature.

questions.qzh: “图书馆很 SILENT，安静得能听到钟声。”SILENT 的意思是……

questions.q: "Unlike her ANXIOUS brother, Emma felt calm before the test." ANXIOUS means...

why.en: Unlike = opposite of calm.
why.zh: unlike = 和 calm 相反。

calm.en: "Unlike" shows an OPPOSITE. Emma was calm, so her brother was the opposite.
calm.zh: unlike 表示相反。Emma 很平静，所以弟弟正相反。

happy.en: The opposite of calm before a test is worried, not happy.
happy.zh: 考试前平静的反义是担心，不是开心。

hungry.en: The sentence compares feelings about the test, not food.
hungry.zh: 句子比较的是对考试的感受，不是吃。

questions.qzh: “和她 ANXIOUS 的弟弟不一样，Emma 考试前很平静。”ANXIOUS 的意思是……

questions.q: "We went to the beach ___ it was sunny."

why.en: "Because" gives the REASON: it was sunny, so that is why we went.
why.zh: because 给出原因：因为是晴天，所以才去。

or.en: "Or" gives a choice; there is no choice here.
or.zh: or 是选择，这里没有选择。

until.en: "Until" is about time; it does not give a reason.
until.zh: until 表示时间，不给原因。

but.en: "But" shows a surprise. Going to the beach when it is sunny is not a surprise.
but.zh: but 表示转折。晴天去海边不是意外。

questions.qzh: “我们去了海边，___ 天气很晴朗。”（选连接词）

questions.q: "I wanted to buy the photo card, ___ I did not have enough money."

why.en: "But" shows a CONTRAST: she wanted the card, yet something stopped her.
why.zh: but 表示转折：她想要卡，但有事阻止了她。

so.en: "So" shows a result. Not having money is not a result of wanting the card.
so.zh: so 表示结果。没钱不是想要卡的结果。

because.en: "Because" gives a reason, but not having money is not WHY she wanted it.
because.zh: because 给出原因，但没钱不是她想要卡的原因。

or.en: "Or" gives a choice between two things.
or.zh: or 是两个之间的选择。

questions.qzh: “我想买那张小卡，___ 我的钱不够。”（选连接词）

questions.q: A person who visits is a...

why.en: visit + -or = visitor. Many "person who" words ending in -t take -or (actor, visitor, inventor).
why.zh: visit + -or = visitor。很多以 -t 结尾的“做……的人”用 -or（actor、visitor、inventor）。

visittor.en: Visit has only ONE t; do not double it.
visittor.zh: visit 只有一个 t，不用双写。

questions.qzh: 来拜访的人是……（选正确的拼写）

questions.q: A person who bakes bread is a...

why.en: Bake ends in e: drop the e, add -er.
why.zh: bake 以 e 结尾：去掉 e，加 -er。

bakor.en: A person who bakes takes -ER: baker.

bakeer.en: Bake already ends in e: drop it before adding -er, so only one e.
bakeer.zh: bake 已经以 e 结尾：加 -er 前去掉 e，所以只有一个 e。

bakker.en: Bake has a LONG a sound, so the k is not doubled.
bakker.zh: bake 是长元音 a，所以 k 不双写。

questions.qzh: 烤面包的人是……（选正确的拼写）

questions.q: "In a castle long ago" is the story's...

why.en: Where and when = setting.
why.zh: 在哪里、什么时候 = 背景。

problem.en: The problem is what goes wrong, not where and when.
problem.zh: 问题是出了什么错，不是在哪里、什么时候。

solution.en: The solution is how the problem is fixed.
solution.zh: 解决办法是问题怎样被解决。

characters.en: Characters are WHO is in the story.

questions.qzh: “很久以前，在一座城堡里”是故事的……

questions.q: In a story, the part where the problem is fixed is the...

why.en: Solution = how the problem is fixed.
why.zh: 解决 = 问题怎样解决。

setting.en: The setting is where and when.
setting.zh: 背景是在哪里、什么时候。

problem.en: The problem is what goes WRONG. Fixing it is the solution.
problem.zh: 问题是出了什么错，解决它才是解决办法。

draft.en: A draft is your first try at writing, not part of the story.
draft.zh: 草稿是你第一次写的稿子，不是故事的一部分。

questions.qzh: 故事里问题被解决的部分是……

questions.q: 2/3 of 12 stickers = ?

why.en: 2/3 of 12: find 1/3 first: 12 ÷ 3 = 4. Then 2 thirds: 4 × 2 = 8 stickers.

4 stickers.en: 4 is only 1/3 of 12. We need 2 thirds: 4 × 2 = 8.

18 stickers.en: 18 is more than 12, but a fraction of 12 must be LESS than 12.
18 stickers.zh: 18 比 12 还多，但 12 的几分之几一定比 12 少。

6 stickers.en: 6 is HALF of 12 (1/2). 2/3 is more than a half: 8.

questions.q: Which spelling is correct?

why.en: Congratulate: drop the e, add -ion.
why.zh: congratulate 去掉 e，加 -ion。

congradulation.en: It is spelled with a T: con-gra-TU-late (it sounds like d, but it is t).
congradulation.zh: 要拼 t：con-gra-tu-late（听起来像 d，其实是 t）。

congratualtion.en: The letters are mixed up: it is -TU-LA-tion.

congratulasion.zh: 这里的 shun 音拼作 -tion。

questions.qzh: 哪个拼写是正确的？

canNow.en: I can now use everything from this week by myself.
canNow.zh: 我现在能自己用上本周学的所有内容。

intro.en: Change to improper fractions FIRST. Then multiply.
intro.zh: 先变成假分数，再乘。

canNow.en: I can now multiply mixed numbers.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以做带分数乘法。

questions.q: Change 3 1/4 to an improper fraction.

why.en: Whole × bottom, then add the top: 3 × 4 = 12, 12 + 1 = 13. Keep the bottom: 13/4.

7/4.en: 7/4 adds 3 + 4. The whole number must be MULTIPLIED by the bottom: 3 × 4 = 12.

12/4.en: 12/4 forgets to add the 1 on top: 12 + 1 = 13.

4/4.en: 4/4 adds 3 + 1, which is just 1 whole. 3 1/4 is more than 3.

questions.qzh: 把 3 1/4 变成假分数。

questions.q: Change 2 2/5 to an improper fraction.

why.en: Whole × bottom, then add the top: 2 × 5 = 10, 10 + 2 = 12. So 12/5.

9/5.en: 9/5 adds 2 + 2 + 5. The whole number must be MULTIPLIED by 5.

10/5.en: 10/5 forgets to add the 2 on top: 10 + 2 = 12.

4/5.en: 4/5 is less than 1, but 2 2/5 is more than 2.

questions.qzh: 把 2 2/5 变成假分数。

questions.q: Change 11/4 to a mixed number.

why.en: Divide the top by the bottom: 11 ÷ 4 = 2 remainder 3. The 2 is the whole number, the 3 goes on top: 2 3/4.
why.zh: 分子除以分母：11 ÷ 4 = 2 余 3。2 是整数，3 放在分子：2 3/4。

3 1/4.en: This swaps the answer and the remainder. 4 goes into 11 only 2 times (4 × 3 = 12 is too big).
3 1/4.zh: 这把商和余数换了。11 里只有 2 个 4（4 × 3 = 12 太大了）。

1 3/4.en: 1 3/4 = 7/4. 4 goes into 11 TWO times, not once.

questions.qzh: 把 11/4 变成带分数。

why.en: Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 3/2 × 3/2. Multiply tops and bottoms: 9/4 = 2 1/4.
why.zh: 先把带分数变成假分数：3/2 × 3/2。分子乘分子、分母乘分母：9/4 = 2 1/4。

1 1/4.en: 1 1/4 multiplies the whole numbers and the fractions separately. Change to improper fractions first: the answer is 2 1/4.
1 1/4.zh: 1 1/4 是把整数和分数分开乘了。要先变成假分数：答案是 2 1/4。

2.en: 2 multiplies only the whole number 1 by 1 1/2 and forgets to multiply the 1/2 too. Change to improper fractions: 3/2 × 3/2 = 2 1/4.
2.zh: 2 只把整数 1 乘了 1 1/2，忘了 1/2 也要乘。要先变成假分数：3/2 × 3/2 = 2 1/4。

3.en: 3 is 1 1/2 + 1 1/2: it adds instead of multiplying.

why.en: Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 7/3 × 3/1. Multiply tops and bottoms: 21/3 = 7.
why.zh: 先把带分数变成假分数：7/3 × 3/1。分子乘分子、分母乘分母：21/3 = 7。

6 1/3.en: 6 1/3 multiplies only the whole number 2 by 3 and forgets to multiply the 1/3 too. Change to improper fractions: 7/3 × 3/1 = 7.
6 1/3.zh: 6 1/3 只把整数 2 乘了 3，忘了 1/3 也要乘。要先变成假分数：7/3 × 3/1 = 7。

6 1/9.en: 6 1/9 is too small. Change to improper fractions and multiply: 7/3 × 3/1 = 7, not 6 1/9.

9.en: 9 is too big. Change to improper fractions and multiply: 7/3 × 3/1 = 7, not 9.
9.zh: 9 太大了。先变成假分数再乘：7/3 × 3/1 = 7，不是 9。

why.en: Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 5/4 × 2/5. Multiply tops and bottoms: 10/20 = 1/2.
why.zh: 先把带分数变成假分数：5/4 × 2/5。分子乘分子、分母乘分母：10/20 = 1/2。

2/5.en: 2/5 is too small. Change to improper fractions and multiply: 5/4 × 2/5 = 1/2, not 2/5.

1 1/10.en: 1 1/10 is too big. Change to improper fractions and multiply: 5/4 × 2/5 = 1/2, not 1 1/10.

5/8.en: 5/8 is too big. Change to improper fractions and multiply: 5/4 × 2/5 = 1/2, not 5/8.

why.en: Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 5/2 × 4/3. Multiply tops and bottoms: 20/6 = 3 1/3.
why.zh: 先把带分数变成假分数：5/2 × 4/3。分子乘分子、分母乘分母：20/6 = 3 1/3。

2 1/6.en: 2 1/6 multiplies the whole numbers and the fractions separately. Change to improper fractions first: the answer is 3 1/3.
2 1/6.zh: 2 1/6 是把整数和分数分开乘了。要先变成假分数：答案是 3 1/3。

3 1/6.en: 3 1/6 multiplies only the whole number 2 by 1 1/3 and forgets to multiply the 1/2 too. Change to improper fractions: 5/2 × 4/3 = 3 1/3.

2 5/6.en: 2 5/6 is too small. Change to improper fractions and multiply: 5/2 × 4/3 = 3 1/3, not 2 5/6.

questions.q: Estimate first: 3 1/4 × 1 3/4 is about...

why.en: Round each mixed number to the nearest whole: 3 1/4 ≈ 3 and 1 3/4 ≈ 2. Then 3 × 2 = 6.

3.en: 3 treats 1 3/4 as 1. But 1 3/4 is close to 2, so the answer is about 6.
3.zh: 3 是把 1 3/4 当成 1。但 1 3/4 接近 2，所以答案大约是 6。

12.en: 12 is far too big: even 4 × 2 is only 8.
12.zh: 12 太大了：就算 4 × 2 也只有 8。

2.en: Multiplying by more than 1 makes the answer BIGGER than 3 1/4, so it cannot be 2.
2.zh: 乘以大于 1 的数，答案会比 3 1/4 大，不可能是 2。

questions.q: A cat eats 1 1/3 cans of food a day. How many cans in 6 days?

why.en: Same amount each day = multiply: 1 1/3 × 6 = 4/3 × 6/1 = 24/3 = 8 cans.

6 1/3.en: 6 1/3 multiplies only the 1 by 6 and forgets the 1/3: 1/3 × 6 = 2 more.

6 1/18.en: 6 1/18 divides the 1/3 by 6 instead of multiplying it.
6 1/18.zh: 6 1/18 是把 1/3 除以 6 了，应该乘。

questions.qzh: 一只猫每天吃 1 1/3 罐猫粮。6 天吃几罐？

questions.q: Lily's gel pen is 5 1/2 inches long. Her ruler is 2 times as long. How long is the ruler?

why.en: "2 times as long" = multiply: 5 1/2 × 2 = 11/2 × 2/1 = 22/2 = 11 inches.

10 1/2 inches.en: 10 1/2 multiplies the 5 but forgets to multiply the 1/2: 1/2 × 2 = 1 more.

10 inches.en: 10 is only 5 × 2. The extra 1/2 inch also doubles: + 1.
10 inches.zh: 10 只是 5 × 2。多出来的 1/2 也要翻倍：再加 1。

7 1/2 inches.en: 7 1/2 is 5 1/2 + 2: it adds instead of multiplying.

questions.qzh: Lily 的中性笔长 5 1/2 英寸。她的尺子是笔的 2 倍长。尺子有多长？

title.zh: 配对游戏：带分数和假分数

intro.en: Tap a mixed number, then the same amount as an improper fraction.
intro.zh: 先点带分数，再点和它相等的假分数。

canNow.en: I can now change mixed numbers to improper fractions quickly.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以快速把带分数变成假分数。

intro.en: Improper first, then Keep, Change, Flip.
intro.zh: 先变假分数，再“不变、变号、倒过来”。

canNow.en: I can now divide mixed numbers.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以做带分数除法。

why.en: Change to improper fractions, then Keep, Change, Flip: 5/2 × 2/1 = 5.
why.zh: 先变成假分数，再 Keep、Change、Flip：5/2 × 2/1 = 5。

1 1/4.en: 1 1/4 is 2 1/2 × 1/2: it multiplied without flipping. Keep, Change, Flip.
1 1/4.zh: 1 1/4 是 2 1/2 × 1/2，没有倒过来就乘了。要 Keep、Change、Flip。

2.en: Dividing by a number smaller than 1 makes the answer BIGGER than 2 1/2, but 2 is smaller. Check: 2 × 1/2 = 1, not 2 1/2.
2.zh: 除以小于 1 的数，答案会比 2 1/2 大，但 2 更小。检查：2 × 1/2 = 1，不是 2 1/2。

why.en: Change to improper fractions, then Keep, Change, Flip: 10/3 × 3/2 = 5.
why.zh: 先变成假分数，再 Keep、Change、Flip：10/3 × 3/2 = 5。

2 2/9.en: 2 2/9 is 3 1/3 × 2/3: it multiplied without flipping. Keep, Change, Flip.
2 2/9.zh: 2 2/9 是 3 1/3 × 2/3，没有倒过来就乘了。要 Keep、Change、Flip。

1 1/5.en: Dividing by a number smaller than 1 makes the answer BIGGER than 3 1/3, but 1 1/5 is smaller. Check: 1 1/5 × 2/3 = 4/5, not 3 1/3.

why.en: Change to improper fractions, then Keep, Change, Flip: 3/2 × 4/3 = 2.
why.zh: 先变成假分数，再 Keep、Change、Flip：3/2 × 4/3 = 2。

1 1/8.en: 1 1/8 is 1 1/2 × 3/4: it multiplied without flipping. Keep, Change, Flip.
1 1/8.zh: 1 1/8 是 1 1/2 × 3/4，没有倒过来就乘了。要 Keep、Change、Flip。

1/2.en: 1/2 flips the FIRST number. Keep the first, flip the second.
1/2.zh: 1/2 是倒了第一个数。第一个不变，倒第二个。

4/3.en: Dividing by a number smaller than 1 makes the answer BIGGER than 1 1/2, but 4/3 is smaller. Check: 4/3 × 3/4 = 1, not 1 1/2.
4/3.zh: 除以小于 1 的数，答案会比 1 1/2 大，但 4/3 更小。检查：4/3 × 3/4 = 1，不是 1 1/2。

why.en: Change to improper fractions, then Keep, Change, Flip: 9/2 × 2/3 = 3.
why.zh: 先变成假分数，再 Keep、Change、Flip：9/2 × 2/3 = 3。

6 3/4.en: 6 3/4 is 4 1/2 × 1 1/2: it multiplied without flipping. Keep, Change, Flip.
6 3/4.zh: 6 3/4 是 4 1/2 × 1 1/2，没有倒过来就乘了。要 Keep、Change、Flip。

why.en: Change to improper fractions, then Keep, Change, Flip: 5/1 × 4/5 = 4.
why.zh: 先变成假分数，再 Keep、Change、Flip：5/1 × 4/5 = 4。

6 1/4.en: 6 1/4 is 5 + 1 1/4: it adds instead of dividing.

why.en: Change to improper fractions, then Keep, Change, Flip: 9/4 × 2/3 = 1 1/2.
why.zh: 先变成假分数，再 Keep、Change、Flip：9/4 × 2/3 = 1 1/2。

3 3/8.en: 3 3/8 is 2 1/4 × 1 1/2: it multiplied without flipping. Keep, Change, Flip.
3 3/8.zh: 3 3/8 是 2 1/4 × 1 1/2，没有倒过来就乘了。要 Keep、Change、Flip。

2/3.en: 2/3 flips the FIRST number. Keep the first, flip the second.
2/3.zh: 2/3 是倒了第一个数。第一个不变，倒第二个。

questions.q: In 3 3/4 ÷ 1 1/4, which fraction do you flip?

why.en: Change both to improper fractions: 15/4 ÷ 5/4. Keep the FIRST, flip only the SECOND (the one you divide by): 5/4 → 4/5.
why.zh: 先都变成假分数：15/4 ÷ 5/4。第一个不变，只倒第二个（除数）：5/4 → 4/5。

15/4.en: 15/4 is the FIRST number. Keep it as it is.

both.en: Flipping both gives the wrong answer. Only the number you divide BY is flipped.
both.zh: 两个都倒会得到错误答案。只倒除数。

neither.en: Dividing by a fraction needs a flip: Keep, Change, Flip.

questions.qzh: 在 3 3/4 ÷ 1 1/4 里，要把哪个分数倒过来？

questions.q: Emma has 6 cups of flour. Each cake needs 1 1/2 cups. How many cakes?

9.en: 9 is 6 × 1 1/2: it multiplied. Each cake USES flour, so divide.
9.zh: 9 是 6 × 1 1/2，乘了。每个蛋糕用掉面粉，要用除。

3.en: Check: 3 cakes × 1 1/2 = 4 1/2 cups, but she has 6.

5.en: Check: 5 cakes × 1 1/2 = 7 1/2 cups, more than her 6 cups.

questions.qzh: Emma 有 6 杯面粉，每个蛋糕要 1 1/2 杯。能做几个蛋糕？

questions.q: A 7 1/2 m rope is cut into pieces 2 1/2 m long. How many pieces?

why.en: "How many 2 1/2 in 7 1/2?" = divide: 15/2 × 2/5 = 30/10 = 3 pieces.

18 3/4.en: 18 3/4 is 7 1/2 × 2 1/2: it multiplied. Cutting into pieces means divide.

5.en: Check: 5 × 2 1/2 = 12 1/2 m, but the rope is 7 1/2 m.

2.en: Check: 2 × 2 1/2 = 5 m, leaving 2 1/2 m for one more piece.
2.zh: 检查：2 × 2 1/2 = 5 米，还剩 2 1/2 米可以再剪一段。

questions.qzh: 一根 7 1/2 米的绳子剪成每段 2 1/2 米。能剪几段？

questions.q: Daisy swims 4 laps in 2/3 of an hour. Is 4 ÷ 2/3 bigger or smaller than 4?

why.en: 2/3 is less than 1, so the answer is bigger: 4/1 × 3/2 = 12/2 = 6.

smaller: 2 2/3.en: 2 2/3 is 4 × 2/3: it multiplied. Dividing by a number less than 1 gives a BIGGER answer.
smaller: 2 2/3.zh: 2 2/3 是 4 × 2/3，乘了。除以小于 1 的数，答案会更大。

the same: 4.en: Only dividing by 1 keeps the number the same. 2/3 is less than 1.
the same: 4.zh: 只有除以 1 数才不变。2/3 小于 1。

smaller: 1/6.en: 1/6 is the right answer (6) upside down. 4 ÷ 2/3 = 4 × 3/2 = 6.

questions.qzh: Daisy 在 2/3 小时里游了 4 圈。4 ÷ 2/3 比 4 大还是小？

intro.en: Say the answer, then flip to check.
intro.zh: 先说答案，再翻过来检查。

canNow.en: I can now remember the unit facts.
canNow.zh: 我现在记住了单位换算。

intro.en: Big to small: ×. Small to big: ÷.
intro.zh: 大到小：×。小到大：÷。

canNow.en: I can now convert units, even with fractions.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以换算单位，带分数也可以。

questions.q: 4 ft = ? in

why.en: 1 ft = 12 in. Feet are BIGGER than inches, so you get MORE inches: multiply. 4 × 12 = 48 in.
why.zh: 1 英尺 = 12 英寸。英尺比英寸大，换成英寸数会变多：乘。4 × 12 = 48 英寸。

16 in.en: 16 is 4 + 12: it adds. Each foot is 12 inches, so multiply.
16 in.zh: 16 是 4 + 12，加了。每英尺是 12 英寸，要乘。

40 in.en: 40 uses 10 inches in a foot. There are 12: 4 × 12 = 48.

1/3 in.en: 1/3 is 4 ÷ 12: it divides. Going from big to small units means MULTIPLY.
1/3 in.zh: 1/3 是 4 ÷ 12，除了。从大单位换到小单位要乘。

questions.qzh: 4 英尺 = ? 英寸

questions.q: 3 lb = ? oz

why.en: 1 lb = 16 oz. Big to small: multiply. 3 × 16 = 48 oz.

30 oz.en: 30 uses 10 oz in a pound. There are 16.
30 oz.zh: 30 是用 1 磅 = 10 盎司算的。其实是 16。

24 oz.en: 24 uses 8 oz in a pound. There are 16 oz in 1 lb.
24 oz.zh: 24 是用 1 磅 = 8 盎司算的。1 磅是 16 盎司。

questions.qzh: 3 磅 = ? 盎司

questions.q: 5 pt = ? c

why.en: 1 pt = 2 c. Big to small: multiply. 5 × 2 = 10 c.

2 1/2 c.en: 2 1/2 is 5 ÷ 2: it divides. Pints are bigger than cups, so you get MORE cups.
2 1/2 c.zh: 2 1/2 是 5 ÷ 2，除了。品脱比杯大，换成杯会更多。

40 c.en: 40 uses 8 cups in a pint. 1 pint is only 2 cups.
40 c.zh: 40 是用 1 品脱 = 8 杯算的。1 品脱只有 2 杯。

questions.qzh: 5 品脱 = ? 杯

questions.q: 18 in = ? ft

why.en: 1 ft = 12 in. Small to big: divide. 18 ÷ 12 = 18/12 = 3/2 = 1 1/2 ft.

216 ft.en: 216 is 18 × 12: it multiplied. Inches are SMALL, so you get FEWER feet.
216 ft.zh: 216 是 18 × 12，乘了。英寸是小单位，换成英尺会更少。

1 1/4 ft.en: 1 1/4 ft = 15 in. 18 in is 12 + 6, which is 1 1/2 ft.

6 ft.en: 6 is 18 ÷ 3 (yards use 3). For feet, divide by 12.

questions.qzh: 18 英寸 = ? 英尺

questions.q: 8 oz = ? lb

why.en: 1 lb = 16 oz. Small to big: divide. 8 ÷ 16 = 8/16 = 1/2 lb.

2 lb.en: 2 is 16 ÷ 8, upside down. 8 oz is LESS than 1 lb (16 oz).
2 lb.zh: 2 是 16 ÷ 8，倒过来了。8 盎司比 1 磅（16 盎司）少。

128 lb.en: 128 is 8 × 16: it multiplied. Small to big means divide.

1/8 lb.en: 1/8 lb = 2 oz. 8 oz is half of 16, so 1/2 lb.
1/8 lb.zh: 1/8 磅 = 2 盎司。8 盎司是 16 的一半，所以是 1/2 磅。

questions.qzh: 8 盎司 = ? 磅

questions.q: 12 qt = ? gal

why.en: 1 gal = 4 qt. Small to big: divide. 12 ÷ 4 = 3 gal.
why.zh: 1 加仑 = 4 夸脱。小换大：除。12 ÷ 4 = 3 加仑。

48 gal.en: 48 is 12 × 4: it multiplied. Quarts are small, so you get FEWER gallons.
48 gal.zh: 48 是 12 × 4，乘了。夸脱是小单位，换成加仑会更少。

6 gal.en: 6 is 12 ÷ 2 (that would be pints in a quart). 1 gallon is 4 quarts.
6 gal.zh: 6 是 12 ÷ 2。1 加仑是 4 夸脱。

4 gal.zh: 检查：4 加仑 = 16 夸脱，不是 12。

questions.qzh: 12 夸脱 = ? 加仑

questions.q: 2 1/2 yd = ? ft

why.en: 1 yd = 3 ft. Big to small: multiply. 2 1/2 × 3 = 5/2 × 3/1 = 15/2 = 7 1/2 ft.

6 ft.en: 6 is only 2 × 3. The 1/2 yard is 1 1/2 ft more.

30 ft.en: 30 uses 12 (inches in a foot). A yard is 3 FEET.
30 ft.zh: 30 是用 12 算的（英寸）。1 码是 3 英尺。

questions.q: 1 1/2 c = ? fl oz

why.en: 1 c = 8 fl oz. Big to small: multiply. 1 1/2 × 8 = 3/2 × 8/1 = 24/2 = 12 fl oz.

9 fl oz.en: 9 multiplies only the 1 and adds the 1/2 on. 1/2 cup is 4 fl oz: 8 + 4 = 12.
9 fl oz.zh: 9 只乘了 1 再加上 1/2。半杯是 4 液量盎司：8 + 4 = 12。

10 fl oz.en: Check: 1 cup = 8, half a cup = 4, so 8 + 4 = 12, not 10.

16 fl oz.en: 16 fl oz is 2 cups. 1 1/2 cups is less.
16 fl oz.zh: 16 液量盎司是 2 杯。1 1/2 杯更少。

questions.qzh: 1 1/2 杯 = ? 液量盎司

questions.q: To change pounds to ounces you...

why.en: A pound is BIGGER than an ounce (1 lb = 16 oz), so changing pounds to ounces gives more: multiply by 16.
why.zh: 磅比盎司大（1 磅 = 16 盎司），磅换成盎司数会变多：乘以 16。

divide by 16.en: Dividing makes the number smaller. That is for ounces → pounds.
divide by 16.zh: 除会让数变小，那是盎司换磅用的。

multiply by 12.en: 12 is for feet → inches. Pounds use 16.

divide by 12.en: 12 is for length, and dividing is the wrong direction.
divide by 12.zh: 12 是长度用的，而且除方向也错了。

questions.qzh: 把磅换成盎司，你要……

questions.q: A baby elephant weighs 1/4 T. How many pounds is that?

8,000 lb.en: 8,000 is 2,000 × 4: it multiplied by 4. A quarter means divide by 4.

250 lb.zh: 250 是 2,000 ÷ 8（八分之一），不是四分之一。

questions.qzh: 一头小象重 1/4 吨。那是多少磅？

intro.en: Read Main Book M5 first. Then do this. You can try again as many times as you like. No calculator.
intro.zh: 先读主课本 M5，再做（可以做很多次）。不用计算器。

canNow.en: I can now multiply mixed numbers on my own.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以自己做带分数乘法。

questions.q: Change 1 3/8 to an improper fraction.

why.en: Whole × bottom, then add the top: 1 × 8 = 8, 8 + 3 = 11. Keep the bottom: 11/8.

4/8.en: 4/8 adds 1 + 3. The whole number must be MULTIPLIED by 8.

8/11.en: 8/11 is the right answer upside down. The bottom stays 8.
8/11.zh: 8/11 是正确答案倒过来了。分母还是 8。

questions.qzh: 把 1 3/8 变成假分数。

questions.q: Change 17/5 to a mixed number.

why.en: Divide the top by the bottom: 17 ÷ 5 = 3 remainder 2. Whole number 3, remainder 2 on top: 3 2/5.
why.zh: 分子除以分母：17 ÷ 5 = 3 余 2。整数 3，余数 2 放在分子：3 2/5。

2 3/5.en: This swaps the answer and the remainder. 5 goes into 17 THREE times.
2 3/5.zh: 这把商和余数换了。17 里有三个 5。

5 2/3.en: This puts the 5 in the wrong place. The bottom (5) stays the bottom.
5 2/3.zh: 这把 5 放错了位置。分母 5 还是分母。

questions.qzh: 把 17/5 变成带分数。

why.en: Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 5/3 × 3/1. Multiply tops and bottoms: 15/3 = 5.
why.zh: 先把带分数变成假分数：5/3 × 3/1。分子乘分子、分母乘分母：15/3 = 5。

3 2/3.en: 3 2/3 multiplies only the whole number 1 by 3 and forgets to multiply the 2/3 too. Change to improper fractions: 5/3 × 3/1 = 5.
3 2/3.zh: 3 2/3 只把整数 1 乘了 3，忘了 2/3 也要乘。要先变成假分数：5/3 × 3/1 = 5。

4.en: 4 is too small. Change to improper fractions and multiply: 5/3 × 3/1 = 5, not 4.
4.zh: 4 太小了。先变成假分数再乘：5/3 × 3/1 = 5，不是 4。

3 2/9.en: 3 2/9 is too small. Change to improper fractions and multiply: 5/3 × 3/1 = 5, not 3 2/9.

why.en: Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 5/2 × 6/5. Multiply tops and bottoms: 30/10 = 3.
why.zh: 先把带分数变成假分数：5/2 × 6/5。分子乘分子、分母乘分母：30/10 = 3。

2 1/10.en: 2 1/10 multiplies the whole numbers and the fractions separately. Change to improper fractions first: the answer is 3.
2 1/10.zh: 2 1/10 是把整数和分数分开乘了。要先变成假分数：答案是 3。

3 1/2.en: 3 1/2 is too big. Change to improper fractions and multiply: 5/2 × 6/5 = 3, not 3 1/2.

2 1/2.en: 2 1/2 is too small. Change to improper fractions and multiply: 5/2 × 6/5 = 3, not 2 1/2.

why.en: Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 3/4 × 8/3. Multiply tops and bottoms: 24/12 = 2.
why.zh: 先把带分数变成假分数：3/4 × 8/3。分子乘分子、分母乘分母：24/12 = 2。

1 1/2.en: 1 1/2 is too small. Change to improper fractions and multiply: 3/4 × 8/3 = 2, not 1 1/2.

2 1/2.en: 2 1/2 is too big. Change to improper fractions and multiply: 3/4 × 8/3 = 2, not 2 1/2.

6/12.en: 6/12 multiplies the whole numbers and the fractions separately. Change to improper fractions first: the answer is 2.
6/12.zh: 6/12 是把整数和分数分开乘了。要先变成假分数：答案是 2。

why.en: Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 4/3 × 3/2. Multiply tops and bottoms: 12/6 = 2.
why.zh: 先把带分数变成假分数：4/3 × 3/2。分子乘分子、分母乘分母：12/6 = 2。

1 1/6.en: 1 1/6 multiplies the whole numbers and the fractions separately. Change to improper fractions first: the answer is 2.
1 1/6.zh: 1 1/6 是把整数和分数分开乘了。要先变成假分数：答案是 2。

2 1/2.en: 2 1/2 is too big. Change to improper fractions and multiply: 4/3 × 3/2 = 2, not 2 1/2.

1 5/6.en: 1 5/6 multiplies only the whole number 1 by 1 1/2 and forgets to multiply the 1/3 too. Change to improper fractions: 4/3 × 3/2 = 2.
1 5/6.zh: 1 5/6 只把整数 1 乘了 1 1/2，忘了 1/3 也要乘。要先变成假分数：4/3 × 3/2 = 2。

questions.q: A K-pop dance practice lasts 1 3/4 hours. Daisy practises 4 times. How many hours?

why.en: 4 practices of 1 3/4 hours = multiply: 7/4 × 4/1 = 28/4 = 7 hours.

4 3/4.en: 4 3/4 multiplies only the 1 and forgets the 3/4: 3/4 × 4 = 3 more.

7 3/4.en: 7 3/4 adds an extra 3/4 at the end. 1 × 4 = 4 and 3/4 × 4 = 3, so 4 + 3 = 7.

questions.qzh: 一次 K-pop 舞蹈练习 1 3/4 小时。Daisy 练了 4 次。一共几小时？

questions.q: Sophie's cat weighs 4 1/2 kg. Her dog is 2 1/2 times as heavy. How heavy is the dog?

why.en: "2 1/2 times as heavy" = multiply: 9/2 × 5/2 = 45/4 = 11 1/4 kg.

8 1/4 kg.en: 8 1/4 multiplies the whole numbers (4 × 2) and the halves (1/2 × 1/2) separately. Change to improper fractions first.
8 1/4 kg.zh: 8 1/4 是把整数（4 × 2）和分数（1/2 × 1/2）分开乘了。要先变成假分数。

9 kg.en: 9 is 4 1/2 × 2 only. The dog is 2 1/2 times as heavy, so add another half: 9 + 2 1/4.
