7 kg.en: 7 is 4 1/2 + 2 1/2: it adds instead of multiplying.

questions.qzh: Sophie 的猫重 4 1/2 千克。她的狗是猫的 2 1/2 倍重。狗有多重？

intro.en: Read Main Book M5 and M6 first. Then do this. You can try again as many times as you like. No calculator.
intro.zh: 先读主课本 M5 和 M6，再做（可以做很多次）。不用计算器。

canNow.en: I can now choose × or ÷ and work with mixed numbers.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以选对乘或除，并计算带分数。

why.en: Change to improper fractions, then Keep, Change, Flip: 3/1 × 4/3 = 4.
why.zh: 先变成假分数，再 Keep、Change、Flip：3/1 × 4/3 = 4。

2 1/4.en: 2 1/4 is 3 × 3/4: it multiplied without flipping. Keep, Change, Flip.
2 1/4.zh: 2 1/4 是 3 × 3/4，没有倒过来就乘了。要 Keep、Change、Flip。

1/4.en: 1/4 flips the FIRST number. Keep the first, flip the second.
1/4.zh: 1/4 是倒了第一个数。第一个不变，倒第二个。

9/4.en: 9/4 is 3 × 3/4: it multiplied without flipping. Keep, Change, Flip.
9/4.zh: 9/4 是 3 × 3/4，没有倒过来就乘了。要 Keep、Change、Flip。

why.en: Change to improper fractions, then Keep, Change, Flip: 8/3 × 3/2 = 4.
why.zh: 先变成假分数，再 Keep、Change、Flip：8/3 × 3/2 = 4。

1 7/9.en: 1 7/9 is 2 2/3 × 2/3: it multiplied without flipping. Keep, Change, Flip.
1 7/9.zh: 1 7/9 是 2 2/3 × 2/3，没有倒过来就乘了。要 Keep、Change、Flip。

2.en: Dividing by a number smaller than 1 makes the answer BIGGER than 2 2/3, but 2 is smaller. Check: 2 × 2/3 = 1 1/3, not 2 2/3.
2.zh: 除以小于 1 的数，答案会比 2 2/3 大，但 2 更小。检查：2 × 2/3 = 1 1/3，不是 2 2/3。

why.en: Change to improper fractions, then Keep, Change, Flip: 7/2 × 4/7 = 2.
why.zh: 先变成假分数，再 Keep、Change、Flip：7/2 × 4/7 = 2。

6 1/8.en: 6 1/8 is 3 1/2 × 1 3/4: it multiplied without flipping. Keep, Change, Flip.
6 1/8.zh: 6 1/8 是 3 1/2 × 1 3/4，没有倒过来就乘了。要 Keep、Change、Flip。

1/2.en: 1/2 flips the FIRST number. Keep the first, flip the second.
1/2.zh: 1/2 是倒了第一个数。第一个不变，倒第二个。

why.en: Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 5/4 × 12/5. Multiply tops and bottoms: 60/20 = 3.
why.zh: 先把带分数变成假分数：5/4 × 12/5。分子乘分子、分母乘分母：60/20 = 3。

2 1/10.en: 2 1/10 multiplies the whole numbers and the fractions separately. Change to improper fractions first: the answer is 3.
2 1/10.zh: 2 1/10 是把整数和分数分开乘了。要先变成假分数：答案是 3。

2 1/2.en: 2 1/2 is too small. Change to improper fractions and multiply: 5/4 × 12/5 = 3, not 2 1/2.

3 1/4.en: 3 1/4 is too big. Change to improper fractions and multiply: 5/4 × 12/5 = 3, not 3 1/4.

why.en: Change to improper fractions, then Keep, Change, Flip: 25/4 × 4/5 = 5.
why.zh: 先变成假分数，再 Keep、Change、Flip：25/4 × 4/5 = 5。

7 13/16.en: 7 13/16 is 6 1/4 × 1 1/4: it multiplied without flipping. Keep, Change, Flip.
7 13/16.zh: 7 13/16 是 6 1/4 × 1 1/4，没有倒过来就乘了。要 Keep、Change、Flip。

questions.q: A bubble tea shop uses 2 1/2 bags of tapioca a day. How many bags in 4 days?

why.en: The same amount every day = multiply: 5/2 × 4/1 = 20/2 = 10 bags.

8 1/2.en: 8 1/2 multiplies only the 2 and forgets the 1/2: 1/2 × 4 = 2 more.

1 3/5.en: 1 3/5 is 4 ÷ 2 1/2: it divides. Using bags every day means multiply.
1 3/5.zh: 1 3/5 是 4 ÷ 2 1/2，除了。每天都用要用乘。

6 1/2.en: 6 1/2 is 2 1/2 + 4: it adds instead of multiplying.

questions.qzh: 一家珍珠奶茶店每天用 2 1/2 袋珍珠。4 天用几袋？

questions.q: James has 5 1/4 m of string. Each bracelet needs 3/4 m. How many bracelets?

why.en: "How many 3/4 in 5 1/4?" = divide: 21/4 × 4/3 = 84/12 = 7 bracelets.

3 15/16.en: 3 15/16 is 5 1/4 × 3/4: it multiplied. Cutting string into pieces means divide.
3 15/16.zh: 3 15/16 是 5 1/4 × 3/4，乘了。把绳子剪成几段要用除。

6.en: Check: 6 × 3/4 = 4 1/2 m, leaving 3/4 m for one more bracelet.
6.zh: 检查：6 × 3/4 = 4 1/2 米，还剩 3/4 米能再做一条。

8.en: Check: 8 × 3/4 = 6 m, but he only has 5 1/4 m.

questions.qzh: James 有 5 1/4 米绳子，每条手链要 3/4 米。他能做几条手链？

questions.q: Which one will give an answer BIGGER than 8?

why.en: Dividing by a number less than 1 makes it bigger: 8 ÷ 2/3 = 12.
why.zh: 除以小于 1 的数会变大：8 ÷ 2/3 = 12。

8 ÷ 1 1/3.en: Dividing by a number BIGGER than 1 makes the answer smaller: 8 ÷ 1 1/3 = 6.
8 ÷ 1 1/3.zh: 除以大于 1 的数，答案会变小：8 ÷ 1 1/3 = 6。

8 × 1/2.en: Multiplying by a number less than 1 makes it smaller: 8 × 1/2 = 4.
8 × 1/2.zh: 乘以小于 1 的数会变小：8 × 1/2 = 4。

questions.qzh: 哪一个的答案会比 8 大？

intro.en: Read Main Book R6, E4 and E5 first. Then do this. You can try again as many times as you like.
intro.zh: 先读主课本 R6、E4 和 E5，再做（可以做很多次）。

canNow.en: I can now use context clues, joining words and -er / -or.
canNow.zh: 我现在会用上下文线索、连接词和 -er / -or。

questions.q: The kitten was famished, which means very hungry. What does famished mean?

why.en: The sentence tells you: "which means very hungry".
why.zh: 句子直接告诉你：“which means very hungry”。

very sleepy.en: The sentence says "which means very hungry", not sleepy.
very sleepy.zh: 句子说的是 which means very hungry，不是困。

very small.en: Size is not mentioned; the meaning is given right after the word.
very small.zh: 没有提到大小；意思就写在这个词后面。

very happy.en: The sentence gives the meaning directly: very hungry.
very happy.zh: 句子直接给出了意思：very hungry。

questions.qzh: 小猫很 famished，意思是非常饿。famished 是什么意思？

questions.q: Tom was timid, but his sister was bold and brave. Timid means...

why.en: "but" tells you an opposite is coming. The opposite of brave is shy and scared.
why.zh: “but”表示后面是相反的意思。brave 的反义是胆小。

brave.en: "But" shows an OPPOSITE. His SISTER was brave, so Tom was the opposite.
brave.zh: but 表示相反。他姐姐勇敢，所以 Tom 正相反。

tall.en: The clue compares how brave they are, not height.
tall.zh: 线索比较的是勇敢，不是身高。

funny.en: The opposite of bold and brave is shy and scared, not funny.
funny.zh: 勇敢的反义是害羞胆小，不是好笑。

questions.qzh: Tom 很 timid，但他姐姐又大胆又勇敢。timid 的意思是……

questions.q: Emma loves citrus fruits, such as lemons, limes and oranges. Citrus fruits are...

why.en: "such as" gives examples: lemons, limes and oranges.
why.zh: “such as”后面是例子：柠檬、青柠和橙子。

sweet berries.en: Lemons and limes are sour, and they are not berries.
sweet berries.zh: 柠檬和青柠是酸的，也不是浆果。

vegetables.en: The examples are fruits, not vegetables.
vegetables.zh: 例子都是水果，不是蔬菜。

dried fruits.en: Lemons and oranges are fresh and juicy, not dried.
dried fruits.zh: 柠檬和橙子是新鲜多汁的，不是干的。

questions.qzh: Emma 喜欢 citrus fruits，比如柠檬、青柠和橙子。citrus fruits 是……

ozh.sour, juicy fruits like lemons: 像柠檬一样酸、多汁的水果

questions.q: Choose the best joining word: Daisy was tired, ___ she still went swimming.

why.en: Being tired and still going is a surprise, so use but.
why.zh: 累了还去游泳，是转折，所以用 but。

so.en: "So" shows a result. Going swimming is not a RESULT of being tired.
so.zh: so 表示结果。去游泳不是累的结果。

because.en: "Because" gives a reason. Being tired is not why she went swimming.
because.zh: because 给出原因。累不是她去游泳的原因。

or.en: "Or" gives a choice; here both things happened.
or.zh: or 是选择；这里两件事都发生了。

questions.qzh: 选最好的连接词：Daisy 很累，___ 她还是去游泳了。

questions.q: Choose the best joining word: Lily was late ___ she missed the bus.

why.en: Missing the bus is the REASON she was late: because.
why.zh: 错过公交车是迟到的原因：because。

but.en: "But" shows a surprise. Being late after missing the bus is not a surprise; it is the reason.
but.zh: but 表示意外。错过公交车而迟到不意外，那是原因。

or.en: "Or" gives a choice between two things.
or.zh: or 是两样之间的选择。

although.en: "Although" shows a contrast, not a reason.
although.zh: although 表示让步，不是原因。

questions.qzh: 选最好的连接词：Lily 迟到了，___ 她错过了公交车。

questions.q: Which sentence has the comma in the right place?
options: I love, cats so I visit the cat cafe.
I love cats so, I visit the cat cafe.
I, love cats so I visit the cat cafe.
I love cats, so I visit the cat cafe.

why.en: Two full sentences joined by so: the comma goes before so.
why.zh: so 连接两个完整的句子：逗号放在 so 前面。

I love, cats so I visit the cat cafe..en: This comma is in the wrong place. When two full sentences are joined with so, the comma goes just BEFORE so.
I love, cats so I visit the cat cafe..zh: 这个逗号放错了。两个完整的句子用 so 连接时，逗号放在 so 的前面。

I love cats so, I visit the cat cafe..en: This comma is in the wrong place. When two full sentences are joined with so, the comma goes just BEFORE so.
I love cats so, I visit the cat cafe..zh: 这个逗号放错了。两个完整的句子用 so 连接时，逗号放在 so 的前面。

I, love cats so I visit the cat cafe..en: This comma is in the wrong place. When two full sentences are joined with so, the comma goes just BEFORE so.
I, love cats so I visit the cat cafe..zh: 这个逗号放错了。两个完整的句子用 so 连接时，逗号放在 so 的前面。

questions.qzh: 哪一句的逗号位置正确？

questions.q: A person who swims is a...

why.en: Short word ending in one vowel + m: double the m, then add -er.
why.zh: 短词，结尾是一个元音 + m：双写 m，再加 -er。

swimer.en: Swim has a SHORT vowel (i) and ends in one consonant (m), so double the m before -er: swimmer.
swimer.zh: swim 是短元音（i）加一个辅音（m），加 -er 前要双写 m：swimmer。

swimor.en: A person who swims takes -er, and the m must be doubled: swimmer.
swimor.zh: 游泳的人用 -er，m 还要双写：swimmer。

swimmor.en: The double m is right, but the ending is -er, not -or.
swimmor.zh: 双写 m 对了，但词尾是 -er，不是 -or。

questions.qzh: 游泳的人是……（选正确的拼写）

questions.q: A person who investigates is an...

why.en: Words ending in -ate drop the e and add -or.
why.zh: 以 -ate 结尾的词去掉 e，加 -or。

investigater.en: Words ending in -ate (investigate, educate) take -OR for the person.
investigater.zh: 以 -ate 结尾的词（investigate、educate）表示人时加 -or。

investigatter.en: Drop the e and add -or. The t is never doubled.
investigatter.zh: 去掉 e 加 -or，t 不双写。

investigatior.en: There is no i before -or: investigat + or.

questions.qzh: 做调查的人是……（选正确的拼写）

intro.en: Read Main Book M7 first. Then do this. You can try again as many times as you like. No calculator.
intro.zh: 先读主课本 M7，再做（可以做很多次）。不用计算器。

canNow.en: I can now convert units and use mixed numbers on my own.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以自己换算单位和计算带分数。

questions.q: 5 ft = ? in

why.en: 1 ft = 12 in. Big to small: multiply. 5 × 12 = 60 in.
why.zh: 1 英尺 = 12 英寸。大换小：乘。5 × 12 = 60 英寸。

50 in.en: 50 uses 10 inches in a foot. There are 12.
50 in.zh: 50 是用 1 英尺 = 10 英寸算的。其实是 12。

5/12 in.en: 5/12 is 5 ÷ 12: it divides. Feet → inches gives MORE, so multiply.
5/12 in.zh: 5/12 是 5 ÷ 12，除了。英尺换英寸会变多，要乘。

questions.qzh: 5 英尺 = ? 英寸

questions.q: 40 oz = ? lb

why.en: 1 lb = 16 oz. Small to big: divide. 40 ÷ 16 = 2 remainder 8, and 8/16 = 1/2, so 2 1/2 lb.

640 lb.en: 640 is 40 × 16: it multiplied. Ounces are small, so you get FEWER pounds.
640 lb.zh: 640 是 40 × 16，乘了。盎司是小单位，换成磅会更少。

2 2/5 lb.en: The remainder 8 is out of 16, not 20: 8/16 = 1/2.

4 lb.en: 4 is 40 ÷ 10. A pound is 16 oz, not 10.

questions.qzh: 40 盎司 = ? 磅

questions.q: 3 gal = ? qt

why.en: 1 gal = 4 qt. Big to small: multiply. 3 × 4 = 12 qt.
why.zh: 1 加仑 = 4 夸脱。大换小：乘。3 × 4 = 12 夸脱。

3/4 qt.en: 3/4 is 3 ÷ 4: it divides. Gallons → quarts gives MORE.
3/4 qt.zh: 3/4 是 3 ÷ 4，除了。加仑换夸脱会变多。

6 qt.en: 6 uses 2 quarts in a gallon. There are 4.
6 qt.zh: 6 是用 1 加仑 = 2 夸脱算的。其实是 4。

questions.qzh: 3 加仑 = ? 夸脱

questions.q: 9 ft = ? yd

why.en: 1 yd = 3 ft. Small to big: divide. 9 ÷ 3 = 3 yd.
why.zh: 1 码 = 3 英尺。小换大：除。9 ÷ 3 = 3 码。

27 yd.en: 27 is 9 × 3: it multiplied. Feet are small, so you get FEWER yards.
27 yd.zh: 27 是 9 × 3，乘了。英尺是小单位，换成码会更少。

6 yd.zh: 检查：6 码 = 18 英尺，不是 9。

questions.qzh: 9 英尺 = ? 码

why.en: Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 7/4 × 2/1. Multiply tops and bottoms: 14/4 = 3 1/2.
why.zh: 先把带分数变成假分数：7/4 × 2/1。分子乘分子、分母乘分母：14/4 = 3 1/2。

2 3/4.en: 2 3/4 multiplies only the whole number 1 by 2 and forgets to multiply the 3/4 too. Change to improper fractions: 7/4 × 2/1 = 3 1/2.
2 3/4.zh: 2 3/4 只把整数 1 乘了 2，忘了 3/4 也要乘。要先变成假分数：7/4 × 2/1 = 3 1/2。

3 3/4.en: 3 3/4 is 1 3/4 + 2: it adds instead of multiplying.

2 3/8.en: 2 3/8 is too small. Change to improper fractions and multiply: 7/4 × 2/1 = 3 1/2, not 2 3/8.

why.en: Change to improper fractions, then Keep, Change, Flip: 9/4 × 4/3 = 3.
why.zh: 先变成假分数，再 Keep、Change、Flip：9/4 × 4/3 = 3。

1 11/16.en: 1 11/16 is 2 1/4 × 3/4: it multiplied without flipping. Keep, Change, Flip.
1 11/16.zh: 1 11/16 是 2 1/4 × 3/4，没有倒过来就乘了。要 Keep、Change、Flip。

1/3.en: 1/3 flips the FIRST number. Keep the first, flip the second.
1/3.zh: 1/3 是倒了第一个数。第一个不变，倒第二个。

2.en: Dividing by a number smaller than 1 makes the answer BIGGER than 2 1/4, but 2 is smaller. Check: 2 × 3/4 = 1 1/2, not 2 1/4.
2.zh: 除以小于 1 的数，答案会比 2 1/4 大，但 2 更小。检查：2 × 3/4 = 1 1/2，不是 2 1/4。

questions.q: A recipe needs 3/4 c of milk. Daisy makes 2 1/2 recipes. How many cups?

why.en: 2 1/2 recipes of 3/4 cup = multiply: 3/4 × 5/2 = 15/8 = 1 7/8 c.

3 1/4 c.en: 3 1/4 is 3/4 + 2 1/2: it adds instead of multiplying.

3 1/3 c.en: 3 1/3 is 2 1/2 ÷ 3/4: it divides. Making more recipes means multiply.
3 1/3 c.zh: 3 1/3 是 2 1/2 ÷ 3/4，除了。做好几份要用乘。

questions.qzh: 一个食谱要 3/4 杯牛奶。Daisy 做了 2 1/2 份。要几杯牛奶？

questions.q: A notebook is 8 1/2 inches wide. How wide are 2 notebooks side by side, in feet?

why.en: Two steps. 1) 8 1/2 × 2 = 17 inches. 2) Change to feet: 17 ÷ 12 = 1 remainder 5, so 1 5/12 ft.

17 ft.en: 17 is the answer in INCHES. The question asks for feet: divide by 12.
17 ft.zh: 17 是英寸的答案。题目要英尺：除以 12。

1 1/2 ft.en: 1 1/2 ft = 18 inches. The notebooks are 17 inches.
1 1/2 ft.zh: 1 1/2 英尺 = 18 英寸。本子是 17 英寸。

1 1/4 ft.en: 1 1/4 ft = 15 inches. The notebooks are 17 inches.
1 1/4 ft.zh: 1 1/4 英尺 = 15 英寸。本子是 17 英寸。

questions.qzh: 一本笔记本宽 8 1/2 英寸。两本并排放有多宽？用英尺回答。

intro.en: Get ready for the maths quiz on Tuesday 8 December. Main Book M2, M3, M4, M5 and M6.
intro.zh: 为 12 月 8 日星期二的数学小测做准备。主课本 M2、M3、M4、M5 和 M6。

canNow.en: I am ready to multiply and divide fractions.
canNow.zh: 我准备好做分数乘除了。

why.en: Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 2/3 × 3/4. Multiply tops and bottoms: 6/12 = 1/2.
why.zh: 先把带分数变成假分数：2/3 × 3/4。分子乘分子、分母乘分母：6/12 = 1/2。

5/7.en: 5/7 is too big. Change to improper fractions and multiply: 2/3 × 3/4 = 1/2, not 5/7.

8/9.en: 8/9 is too big. Change to improper fractions and multiply: 2/3 × 3/4 = 1/2, not 8/9.

6/7.en: 6/7 is too big. Change to improper fractions and multiply: 2/3 × 3/4 = 1/2, not 6/7.

why.en: Change to improper fractions, then Keep, Change, Flip: 4/5 × 5/2 = 2.
why.zh: 先变成假分数，再 Keep、Change、Flip：4/5 × 5/2 = 2。

8/25.en: 8/25 is 4/5 × 2/5: it multiplied without flipping. Keep, Change, Flip.
8/25.zh: 8/25 是 4/5 × 2/5，没有倒过来就乘了。要 Keep、Change、Flip。

2/5.en: Dividing by a number smaller than 1 makes the answer BIGGER than 4/5, but 2/5 is smaller. Check: 2/5 × 2/5 = 4/25, not 4/5.

1/2.en: 1/2 flips the FIRST number. Keep the first, flip the second.
1/2.zh: 1/2 是倒了第一个数。第一个不变，倒第二个。

why.en: Change to improper fractions, then Keep, Change, Flip: 6/1 × 3/2 = 9.
why.zh: 先变成假分数，再 Keep、Change、Flip：6/1 × 3/2 = 9。

4.en: 4 is 6 × 2/3: it multiplied without flipping. Keep, Change, Flip.
4.zh: 4 是 6 × 2/3，没有倒过来就乘了。要 Keep、Change、Flip。

1/9.en: 1/9 flips the FIRST number. Keep the first, flip the second.
1/9.zh: 1/9 是倒了第一个数。第一个不变，倒第二个。

3.en: Dividing by a number smaller than 1 makes the answer BIGGER than 6, but 3 is smaller. Check: 3 × 2/3 = 2, not 6.
3.zh: 除以小于 1 的数，答案会比 6 大，但 3 更小。检查：3 × 2/3 = 2，不是 6。

why.en: Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 3/2 × 8/3. Multiply tops and bottoms: 24/6 = 4.
why.zh: 先把带分数变成假分数：3/2 × 8/3。分子乘分子、分母乘分母：24/6 = 4。

2 1/3.en: 2 1/3 multiplies the whole numbers and the fractions separately. Change to improper fractions first: the answer is 4.
2 1/3.zh: 2 1/3 是把整数和分数分开乘了。要先变成假分数：答案是 4。

3 1/3.en: 3 1/3 is too small. Change to improper fractions and multiply: 3/2 × 8/3 = 4, not 3 1/3.

2.en: 2 is too small. Change to improper fractions and multiply: 3/2 × 8/3 = 4, not 2.
2.zh: 2 太小了。先变成假分数再乘：3/2 × 8/3 = 4，不是 2。

why.en: Change to improper fractions, then Keep, Change, Flip: 7/2 × 4/7 = 2.
why.zh: 先变成假分数，再 Keep、Change、Flip：7/2 × 4/7 = 2。

6 1/8.en: 6 1/8 is 3 1/2 × 1 3/4: it multiplied without flipping. Keep, Change, Flip.
6 1/8.zh: 6 1/8 是 3 1/2 × 1 3/4，没有倒过来就乘了。要 Keep、Change、Flip。

1/2.en: 1/2 flips the FIRST number. Keep the first, flip the second.
1/2.zh: 1/2 是倒了第一个数。第一个不变，倒第二个。

questions.q: Which is the same as 2/7 ÷ 3/5?

why.en: Keep the first fraction, change ÷ to ×, flip only the second: 2/7 × 5/3.
why.zh: 第一个分数不变，÷ 变 ×，只把第二个倒过来：2/7 × 5/3。

7/2 × 3/5.en: This flips the FIRST fraction and not the second. Keep the first, flip the second.
7/2 × 3/5.zh: 这倒了第一个分数，没倒第二个。第一个不变，倒第二个。

2/7 × 3/5.en: This changes ÷ to × but forgets to flip 3/5.
2/7 × 3/5.zh: 这把 ÷ 变成了 ×，但忘了把 3/5 倒过来。

7/2 × 5/3.en: This flips BOTH fractions. Only the second one is flipped.
7/2 × 5/3.zh: 这把两个分数都倒了。只倒第二个。

questions.qzh: 哪一个和 2/7 ÷ 3/5 一样？

questions.q: Lily has 3/4 of a pizza. She eats 2/3 of it. How much of a whole pizza did she eat?

why.en: "Of" means multiply: 2/3 × 3/4 = 6/12 = 1/2 of a pizza.

1 1/8 of a pizza.en: 1 1/8 is more than a whole pizza, but she only had 3/4.
1 1/8 of a pizza.zh: 1 1/8 比一整个披萨还多，但她只有 3/4。

5/7 of a pizza.en: 5/7 adds the tops and bottoms. "Of" means multiply.
5/7 of a pizza.zh: 5/7 是分子分母相加了。of 表示乘。

questions.qzh: Lily 有 3/4 个披萨，她吃了其中的 2/3。她吃了整个披萨的多少？

questions.q: Daisy has 4 m of ribbon. Each bow needs 2/3 m. How many bows can she make?

2 2/3 bows.en: 2 2/3 is 4 × 2/3: it multiplied. Cutting ribbon into pieces means divide.
2 2/3 bows.zh: 2 2/3 是 4 × 2/3，乘了。把丝带剪成几段要用除。

8 bows.en: Check: 8 × 2/3 = 5 1/3 m, but she has only 4 m.

3 bows.en: Check: 3 × 2/3 = 2 m, leaving 2 m for 3 more bows.
3 bows.zh: 检查：3 × 2/3 = 2 米，还剩 2 米能再做 3 个。

questions.qzh: Daisy 有 4 米丝带，每个蝴蝶结要 2/3 米。她能做几个蝴蝶结？

questions.q: A pool is 25 m long. Emma swims 2 1/2 lengths. How far does she swim?

50 1/2 m.en: 50 1/2 multiplies 25 × 2 and just adds the 1/2. Half a length is 12 1/2 m: 50 + 12 1/2.

10 m.en: 10 is 25 ÷ 2 1/2: it divides. Swimming more lengths means multiply.
10 m.zh: 10 是 25 ÷ 2 1/2，除了。游好几个来回要用乘。

27 1/2 m.en: 27 1/2 is 25 + 2 1/2: it adds instead of multiplying.

questions.qzh: 泳池长 25 米。Emma 游了 2 1/2 个泳池长。她游了多远？

questions.q: 2 1/4 kg of sweets are shared equally into 3 bags. How much is in each bag?

why.en: Shared equally = divide: 9/4 ÷ 3 = 9/4 × 1/3 = 9/12 = 3/4 kg in each bag.

6 3/4 kg.en: 6 3/4 is 2 1/4 × 3: it multiplied. Sharing makes each bag SMALLER.
6 3/4 kg.zh: 6 3/4 是 2 1/4 × 3，乘了。分开装每袋会更少。

2 1/12 kg.en: 2 1/12 divides only the 1/4 by 3 and leaves the 2. Change to 9/4 first.
2 1/12 kg.zh: 2 1/12 只把 1/4 除以 3，2 没有除。要先变成 9/4。

1 1/3 kg.en: 1 1/3 is 3 ÷ 2 1/4, the wrong way round. Check: 3 × 1 1/3 = 4 kg, more than 2 1/4.

questions.qzh: 2 1/4 千克糖果平均装进 3 个袋子。每袋有多少？

title.zh: 第 1 天：故事侦探（阅读考试复习）

title.en: Page 1: The 10 Test Words + Which Person?
title.zh: 第 1 页：10 个考试词汇 + 第几人称？

items.q: Match: Point of View
items.right: D: WHO is telling the story

why.en: Point of View = WHO is telling the story.
why.zh: Point of View = 谁在讲故事。

items.q: Match: Perspective
items.right: I: HOW a character sees something, from their own life

why.en: Perspective = HOW a character sees something, from their own life.
why.zh: Perspective = 人物怎样看一件事。

items.q: Match: First Person
items.right: B: the narrator is IN the story: I, me, my, we

why.en: First Person = the narrator is IN the story: I, me, my, we.
why.zh: First Person = 叙述者在故事里：I、me、my、we。

items.q: Match: Second Person
items.right: G: the narrator talks straight to the reader: you, your

why.en: Second person = the narrator talks to YOU, the reader.
why.zh: 第二人称 = 叙述者直接对“你”（读者）说话。

items.q: Match: Third Person Objective
items.right: J: outside narrator, knows NOBODY's feelings (a camera)

why.en: Objective = like a camera.
why.zh: 客观 = 像摄像机。

items.q: Match: Third Person Limited
items.right: E: outside narrator, knows ONE character's feelings

why.en: Limited = one mind.
why.zh: 有限 = 一个人的想法。

items.q: Match: Third Person Omniscient
items.right: H: outside narrator, knows ALL characters' feelings

why.en: Omni = all.
why.zh: omni = 全部。

items.q: Match: Narrator
items.right: A: the one who is telling the story

why.en: The narrator is the storyteller.
why.zh: 叙述者就是讲故事的人。

items.q: Match: Dialogue
items.right: F: the words characters say, inside " "

why.en: Dialogue is inside speech marks.
why.zh: 对话在引号里。

items.q: Match: Theme
items.right: C: the life lesson of the story (NOT a summary)

why.en: Theme = the lesson.
why.zh: 主题 = 道理。

items.q: We packed our swimming bags and ran to catch the school bus.

why.en: Clue words: we, our.
why.zh: 线索词：we、our。

items.q: Have you ever eaten durian? You will never forget the smell!

why.en: Clue words: you.
why.zh: 线索词：you。

items.q: Sophie bought a photo card of her favourite singer. She smiled all the way home.

why.en: Clue words: Sophie, her, she.
why.zh: 线索词：Sophie、her、she。

items.q: "You are my best friend!" Lily told Emma. Then they hugged.
"I won, I won!" Tom shouted. He held his gold medal high.

why.en: Cover "I won". Clue words left: Tom, he.
why.zh: 遮住 “I won”。剩下的线索词：Tom、he。

title.en: Page 2: Whose Feelings Do I Know? + Perspective
title.zh: 第 2 页：我知道谁的感受？+ 看法

items.q: James and Tom carried the bread to the hall. They put it on the long table.

why.en: Only actions, no feelings: like a camera.
why.zh: 只有动作，没有感受：像摄像机。

items.q: Lily wanted to sing on stage, but she was scared her voice would shake.

why.en: We only know what ONE person thinks or feels. One person = limited.
why.zh: 我们只知道一个人的想法或感受。一个人 = 有限。

items.q: Daisy felt proud of her drawing. Emma felt a little jealous, and the teacher was delighted.

why.en: We know the feelings of Daisy, Emma AND the teacher: everyone.
why.zh: 我们知道 Daisy、Emma 和老师的感受：所有人。

items.q: The swimmers dived into the pool. The crowd clapped and cheered.

why.en: Only actions. No thoughts or feelings.
why.zh: 只有动作，没有想法或感受。

items.q: Sophie was nervous about the test, and Lily was worried about her too. Their teacher felt sure they would both do well.

why.en: Three people's feelings: everyone.
why.zh: 三个人的感受：所有人。

items.q: Tom smiled at the new girl. He hoped she would sit next to him at lunch.

why.en: We only know what ONE person thinks or feels. One person = limited.
why.zh: 我们只知道一个人的想法或感受。一个人 = 有限。

items.q: Why does Daisy feel sad about the rain?
items.right: B) Her swimming lesson is cancelled.

why.en: The story says so.
why.zh: 故事里写的。

items.q: Why does Farmer Tom feel happy about the same rain?

why.en: His rice plants are thirsty.
why.zh: 他的稻田需要水。

items.q: What is "perspective"?
items.right: D) how a character sees something

why.en: Perspective = HOW a character sees something, because of their own life.
why.zh: 看法 = 人物怎样看一件事，因为他们自己的经历。

title.en: Page 3: The Lost Photo Card + Theme
title.zh: 第 3 页：丢失的小卡 + 主题

items.q: What is the point of view of "The Lost Photo Card"?

why.en: My, I, me: the narrator is in the story.
why.zh: My、I、me：叙述者在故事里。

items.q: Who is the narrator?

why.en: "My name is Emma."
why.zh: “My name is Emma.”

items.q: How did Emma feel when she FIRST found the card?

why.en: "I was so excited."
why.zh: “I was so excited.”

items.q: Why was the card so special to Sophie?
items.right: A) It was a gift from her sister.

why.en: "My sister gave it to me for my birthday."
why.zh: “My sister gave it to me for my birthday.”

items.q: Which is the BEST theme of the story?
items.right: D) Doing the right thing feels better than keeping what is not yours.

why.en: A theme is a life lesson for EVERYONE.
why.zh: 主题是给每个人的人生道理。

items.q: "Emma gave the card back to Sophie." Theme or summary?

why.en: It tells what happened and has names.
why.zh: 讲发生了什么，还有名字。

items.q: "Be honest, even when nobody is watching." Theme or summary?

why.en: A lesson for everyone, no names.
why.zh: 给每个人的道理，没有名字。

why.en: 3/1 × 2/5 = 6/5. Even better: change it to a mixed number, 1 1/5.
6/15 simplifies to 2/5.

items.q: For 2/3 ÷ 4/5, what do you do FIRST?

why.en: KEEP comes first.
why.zh: 第一步是“不变”。

title.zh: 第 6 页：咖啡馆应用题

items.q: Daisy has 3/4 of a bubble tea. She drinks 1/2 of it. What fraction of the whole tea does she drink?
Lily has 6 metres of ribbon. Each bow needs 3/4 of a metre. How many bows?

why.en: How many ... in? = divide: 6 ÷ 3/4 = 8.

items.q: Emma swims 3/5 km every day. How far in 4 days?
4 friends share 2/3 kg of nuts equally. How much does each friend get?

why.en: Share equally = divide: 2/3 ÷ 4 = 2/3 × 1/4 = 2/12 = 1/6 kg.

items.q: Sophie has 150 baht. She spends 2/5 of it on gel pens. How much?
James has 3 loaves. Each child gets 3/8 of a loaf. How many children get bread?

why.en: How many ... ? = divide: 3 ÷ 3/8 = 3/1 × 8/3 = 24/3 = 8 children.

title.en: Page 1: The 5 Parts of a Speech
title.zh: 第 1 页：演讲的 5 个部分

items.q: Which part of the speech? "Finally, Grandma tasted my dumplings and said they were perfect."
Which part of the speech? "I learned that making mistakes is part of learning something new."
Which part of the speech? "It was Chinese New Year, and I was in Grandma's kitchen."
Which part of the speech? "Have you ever tried to cook something and made a big mess?"
Which part of the speech? "Then, something unexpected happened: my first dumpling burst open in the pot!"

title.en: Page 2: Write the Rest of MY Speech
title.zh: 第 2 页：写完我的演讲稿

items.q: Write the Middle, End and Conclusion of MY speech.
items.right: 2 to 4 sentences for each part, using the starters: Suddenly... / In the end... / This experience taught me that...

items.q: Fix: My grandma smiled she gave me a big hug.
items.right: My grandma smiled, and she gave me a big hug.

why.en: Comma + and joins the two ideas.
why.zh: 逗号 + and 把两个意思连起来。

items.q: Fix: It was my first concert, I felt very excited.
items.right: It was my first concert, so I felt very excited. (or: ...concert. I felt...)

why.en: Fix 1: full stop + capital letter. Fix 2: comma + and / but / so.
why.zh: 改法 1：句号 + 大写。改法 2：逗号 + and / but / so。

items.q: Fix: We got lost in the market we asked a kind lady for help.
items.right: We got lost in the market, so we asked a kind lady for help.

why.en: Joining with "and" fixes it. Even better: add a comma before and.
why.zh: 用 and 连起来就改好了。更好：and 前面加逗号。

items.q: Fix: I dropped my phone, the screen cracked.
items.right: I dropped my phone, and the screen cracked.

why.en: Comma + and: "I dropped my phone, and the screen cracked."
why.zh: 逗号 + and：I dropped my phone, and the screen cracked.

items.q: Fix: The show was over everyone clapped loudly.
items.right: The show was over. Everyone clapped loudly.

why.en: Full stop after "over", then a capital E.
why.zh: 在 over 后面加句号，Everyone 大写。

items.q: Copy one sentence from YOUR speech that you fixed or improved.
items.right: one sentence from your own speech

why.en: This line is for a sentence from your own speech.
why.zh: 这一行要写你自己演讲稿里的一句话。
